words.meaning: Stikka żgħira li tinxtegħel billi togħrok rasha ma’ wiċċ apposta.
words.exampleEnglish: He struck the match to light the candle.

words.meaning: Biċċiet ta’ injam maqtugħin u mnixxfin biex jinħarqu.
words.example: Poġġejna l-ħatab fil-fuklar biex nagħmlu n-nar.
words.exampleEnglish: We put the firewood in the fireplace to make a fire.

words.meaning: Persuna, raġel jew mara; membru tar-razza umana.
words.example: Kull bniedem għandu d-dritt li jgħix b’dinjità.
words.exampleEnglish: Every human being has the right to live with dignity.

words.meaning: Raġel li għadu fl-età żgħira, bejn it-tfulija u l-età adulta.
words.example: Iż-żagħżugħ sab l-ewwel xogħol tiegħu fil-belt.
words.exampleEnglish: The young man found his first job in the city.

words.meaning: Mara żagħżugħa li għadha mhix miżżewġa.
words.example: Ix-xebba libset libsa bajda għall-festa tar-raħal.
words.exampleEnglish: The young woman wore a white dress for the village feast.

words.meaning: Iċ-ċerimonja li fiha żewġ persuni jiżżewġu, u l-festa ta’ magħha.
words.example: It-tieġ ta’ oħti sar f’knisja żgħira fil-kampanja.
words.exampleEnglish: My sister’s wedding took place in a small church in the countryside.

words.meaning: It-tmiem legali taż-żwieġ.
words.example: Wara ħafna snin ta’ problemi, talbu d-divorzju.
words.exampleEnglish: After many years of problems, they asked for a divorce.

words.meaning: L-omm u l-missier ta’ persuna.
words.example: Il-ġenituri ta’ Marija marru jiltaqgħu mal-għalliema.
words.exampleEnglish: Maria’s parents went to meet the teacher.

words.meaning: L-ulied ta’ persuna, subien jew bniet.
words.example: Ix-xjuħ kienu kburin bil-wild u n-neputijiet tagħhom.
words.exampleEnglish: The elderly couple were proud of their children and grandchildren.

words.meaning: Żewġt itfal imwielda mill-istess omm fl-istess ħlas.
words.example: It-tewmin tant jixxiebhu li ħafna ma jagħrfuhomx minn xulxin.
words.exampleEnglish: The twins look so alike that many people cannot tell them apart.

words.meaning: Raġel kbir fl-età.
words.example: Ix-xiħ qagħad fuq il-bank fil-pjazza jitkellem ma’ sħabu.
words.exampleEnglish: The old man sat on the bench in the square chatting with his friends.

words.meaning: Mara kbira fl-età.
words.example: Ix-xiħa kienet tirrakkonta stejjer qodma lin-neputijiet.
words.exampleEnglish: The old woman used to tell old stories to her grandchildren.

words.meaning: It-tifel tal-iben jew tal-bint ta’ persuna (jintuża wkoll għal bin il-ħu jew l-oħt).
words.exampleEnglish: Grandmother took her grandson to school.

words.meaning: It-tifla tal-iben jew tal-bint ta’ persuna (jintuża wkoll għal bint il-ħu jew l-oħt).
words.example: In-nannu xtara rigal sabiħ lin-neputija tiegħu għal għeluq sninha.
words.exampleEnglish: Grandfather bought his granddaughter a nice present for her birthday.

words.meaning: It-tifel taz-ziju jew taz-zija ta’ persuna.
words.exampleEnglish: My cousin came to live near us.

words.meaning: In-nies li minnhom ġejja familja, ħafna ġenerazzjonijiet ilu.
words.example: L-antenati tagħna kienu bdiewa u sajjieda.
words.exampleEnglish: Our ancestors were farmers and fishermen.

words.meaning: In-nies li jitwieldu minn persuna, bħal uliedha, in-neputijiet u ta’ warajhom.
words.example: Id-dixxendenti tal-fundatur għadhom imexxu n-negozju tal-familja.
words.exampleEnglish: The founder’s descendants still run the family business.

words.meaning: Tifel jew tifla li tilfu wieħed jew iż-żewġ ġenituri.
words.example: Wara l-inċident, it-tifel sar iltim u trabba għand iz-zijiet.
words.exampleEnglish: After the accident, the boy was left an orphan and was raised by his aunt and uncle.

words.meaning: Mara li żewġha miet u ma reġgħetx iżżewġet.
words.exampleEnglish: The widow used to go to church every day.

words.meaning: Raġel li martu mietet u ma reġax iżżewweġ.
words.exampleEnglish: The widower lived alone in the big house.

words.meaning: Nies tal-istess familja, minħabba demm jew żwieġ.
words.example: Għall-Milied, il-qraba kollha nġabru għand in-nanna.
words.exampleEnglish: At Christmas, all the relatives gathered at grandmother’s house.

words.meaning: Ħlejqa ħajja li tista’ tiċċaqlaq u tħoss, bħal kelb, għasfur jew ħuta.
words.example: Il-kelb huwa l-annimal favorit ta’ ħafna tfal.
words.exampleEnglish: The dog is many children’s favourite animal.

words.meaning: Annimali tar-razzett bħal baqar, nagħaġ u mogħoż.
words.example: Il-bidwi daħħal il-bhejjem fl-istalla qabel id-dlam.
words.exampleEnglish: The farmer brought the livestock into the stable before dark.

words.meaning: Art miksija bil-ħaxix fejn jirgħu l-annimali.
words.exampleEnglish: The sheep spent the day grazing in the pasture.

words.meaning: Bini fejn jinżammu żwiemel jew annimali oħra.
words.exampleEnglish: The horse was resting in the stable.

words.meaning: Annimali kbar tar-razzett, imrobbija għall-ħalib u l-laħam.
words.example: Il-baqar kienu qed jirgħu fl-għalqa ħdejn ir-razzett.
words.exampleEnglish: The cattle were grazing in the field near the farm.

words.meaning: Il-maskil tal-baqra, kbir u b’saħħtu.
words.example: Il-gendus beda jiġri wara l-kelb fl-għalqa.
words.exampleEnglish: The bull started chasing the dog across the field.

words.meaning: Il-wild tal-baqra.
words.example: L-għoġol twieled filgħodu u malajr qam fuq saqajh.
words.exampleEnglish: The calf was born in the morning and quickly got to its feet.

words.meaning: Il-maskil tan-nagħġa.
words.example: Il-muntun kellu qrun kbar u mdawra.
words.exampleEnglish: The ram had large curled horns.

words.meaning: Il-wild tan-nagħġa.
words.exampleEnglish: The lamb followed its mother in the pasture.

words.meaning: Il-wild tal-mogħża.
words.example: Il-gidi beda jaqbeż fuq il-blat wara ommu.
words.exampleEnglish: The kid started leaping over the rocks after its mother.

words.meaning: Il-femminil taż-żiemel.
words.example: Id-debba kienet qed tredda’ l-felu tagħha.
words.exampleEnglish: The mare was suckling her foal.

words.meaning: Żiemel żgħir, li għadu ma kibirx.
words.example: Il-felu beda jiġri madwar l-għalqa ħdejn ommu.
words.exampleEnglish: The foal started running around the field next to its mother.

words.meaning: Għasfur, speċjalment wieħed tal-irziezet bħat-tiġieġa.
words.example: Tajra bajda niżlet fuq il-ħajt tal-ġnien.
words.exampleEnglish: A white bird landed on the garden wall.

words.meaning: Il-maskil tat-tiġieġa, magħruf għall-għajta tiegħu filgħodu kmieni.
words.example: Is-serduk qajjimna bl-għajta tiegħu qabel sebaħ.
words.exampleEnglish: The rooster woke us with its crowing before dawn.

words.meaning: Għasfur kbir tal-ilma b’għonq twil, imrobbi wkoll fl-irziezet.
words.exampleEnglish: The goose swam quietly in the pond.

words.meaning: Il-post li jibni l-għasfur biex ibid u jrabbi l-frieħ.
words.example: L-għasfur bena bejta fuq il-fergħa tas-siġra.
words.exampleEnglish: The bird built a nest on the branch of the tree.

words.meaning: Għasfur abjad u griż li jgħix qrib il-baħar u jiekol il-ħut.
words.example: Gawwija niżlet fuq id-dgħajsa tfittex il-ħut.
words.exampleEnglish: A seagull landed on the boat looking for fish.

words.meaning: Għasfur tal-priża b’ġwienaħ ippuntati u vista qawwija, li jtir b’ħeffa kbira.
words.example: Il-bies dawwar fl-għoli u mbagħad niżel fuq il-priża.
words.exampleEnglish: The falcon circled high up and then swooped down on its prey.

words.meaning: Għasfur ikkulurit b’munqar mgħawweġ, li xi drabi jitgħallem jimita l-kliem.
words.example: Il-pappagall tan-nanna jgħid “bonġu” lil kull min jidħol.
words.exampleEnglish: Grandmother’s parrot says “good morning” to everyone who comes in.

words.meaning: Għasfur iswed tal-familja tal-għurab, li jgħix fl-irdumijiet u fil-bini.
words.example: Ċawla sewda qagħdet fuq il-kampnar tal-knisja.
words.exampleEnglish: A black jackdaw perched on the church belfry.

words.meaning: Annimal żgħir gerriem b’denb twil, li jgħix fl-għelieqi u xi drabi fid-djar.
words.exampleEnglish: The cat chased a mouse in the storeroom.

words.meaning: Waħda mill-partijiet tal-ġisem li jużaw l-għasafar u l-insetti biex itiru.
words.example: L-għasfur kellu ġewnaħ imweġġa’ u ma setax itir.
words.exampleEnglish: The bird had an injured wing and could not fly.

words.meaning: Waħda mill-biċċiet żgħar u ċatti li jgħattu l-ġilda tal-ħut; tintuża wkoll għall-qoxra tal-frott.
words.example: Qabel sajjar il-ħuta, neħħielha kull qoxra.
words.exampleEnglish: Before cooking the fish, he removed all its scales.

words.meaning: Ħuta twila u żelieqa bħal serp, li tgħix fl-ilma ħelu u fil-baħar.
words.exampleEnglish: The fisherman caught a large eel in the harbour.

words.meaning: Annimal selvaġġ kbir, qrib il-kelb, li jgħix u jikkaċċja fi gruppi.
words.exampleEnglish: At night we heard the wolf howling in the forest.

words.meaning: Il-femminil taċ-ċerv, annimal tal-foresti b’riġlejn twal.
words.example: Iċ-ċerva u l-wild tagħha ħarġu mill-foresta.
words.exampleEnglish: The doe and her fawn came out of the forest.

words.meaning: Annimal kbir tad-deżert b’ħotba jew żewġ ħotbiet fuq dahru.
words.example: Il-ġemel jista’ jgħix ħafna jiem mingħajr ilma.
words.exampleEnglish: The camel can live for many days without water.

words.meaning: Annimal żgħir b’sitt saqajn u ġisem maqsum fi tliet partijiet, bħan-naħla jew in-nemusa.
words.example: Insett żgħir daħal mit-tieqa u beda jtir madwar il-lampa.
words.exampleEnglish: A small insect came in through the window and started flying around the lamp.

words.meaning: Insett żgħir bla ġwienaħ li jgħix fix-xagħar u jixrob id-demm.
words.example: L-iskola bagħtet nota lill-ġenituri għax instabet qamla fil-klassi.
words.exampleEnglish: The school sent a note to parents because a louse was found in the class.

words.meaning: Insett żgħir bla ġwienaħ li jaqbeż ħafna u jgħix fuq il-pil tal-annimali.
words.example: Il-kelb kien qed iħokk għax kellu bergħud.
words.exampleEnglish: The dog was scratching because it had a flea.

words.meaning: Xibka rqiqa ta’ ħjut li tinsiġ il-brimba biex taqbad l-insetti.
words.exampleEnglish: We found a large spider web in the corner of the room.

words.meaning: Insett isfar u iswed li jtir u jista’ jniggeż.
words.example: Żunżana daħlet fil-kċina u kulħadd ħareġ jiġri.
words.exampleEnglish: A wasp got into the kitchen and everyone ran out.

words.meaning: Insett żgħir li jtir u jigdem biex jixrob id-demm.
words.example: Ma rqadtx tajjeb għax nemusa baqgħet iżżanżan ma’ widnejja.
words.exampleEnglish: I didn’t sleep well because a mosquito kept buzzing around my ears.

words.meaning: Annimal żgħir, artab u twil, bla saqajn, li jgħix fil-ħamrija.
words.example: Wara x-xita, ħareġ dudu mill-ħamrija tal-ġnien.
words.exampleEnglish: After the rain, a worm came out of the garden soil.

words.meaning: Annimal żgħir u artab b’qoxra mdawra fuq dahru, li jimxi bil-mod.
words.example: Wara x-xita, bebbuxu tela’ fuq il-ħajt tal-ġnien.
words.exampleEnglish: After the rain, a snail climbed up the garden wall.

words.meaning: Anfibju żgħir b’riġlejn twal ta’ wara li jaqbeż u jgħix qrib l-ilma.
words.exampleEnglish: The frog jumped into the pond when we approached.

words.meaning: Rettili żgħir b’denb twil u erba’ saqajn, li jħobb joqgħod fix-xemx.
words.example: Gremxula kienet qed tieħu x-xemx fuq il-ħajt tas-sejjieħ.
words.exampleEnglish: A lizard was basking in the sun on the rubble wall.

words.meaning: Rettili kbir b’xedaq twil u qawwi u ġilda iebsa, li jgħix fix-xmajjar tal-pajjiżi sħan.
words.example: Il-kukkudrill kien mistoħbi fl-ilma qrib ix-xatt tax-xmara.
words.exampleEnglish: The crocodile was hiding in the water near the riverbank.

words.meaning: Rettili bil-qoxra iebsa fuq dahru, li jgħix fuq l-art jew fil-baħar.
words.example: Fekruna tal-baħar ġiet tbid fuq ir-ramel tar-Ramla l-Ħamra.
words.exampleEnglish: A sea turtle came to lay its eggs on the sand at Ramla l-Ħamra.

words.meaning: L-istruttura fiżika ta’ bniedem jew annimal.
words.exampleEnglish: Regular exercise keeps the body healthy.

words.meaning: Ix-xagħar li jikber fuq il-geddum u l-ħaddejn tar-raġel.
words.example: In-nannu għandu daqna twila u bajda.
words.exampleEnglish: Grandfather has a long white beard.

words.meaning: Il-pil artab tan-nagħaġ, li minnu jsir il-ħajt għall-ħwejjeġ.
words.exampleEnglish: Grandmother knitted me a wool jumper for the winter.

words.meaning: Frak żgħir abjad ta’ ġilda mejta li jaqa’ mill-qorriegħa.
words.exampleEnglish: He bought a special shampoo against dandruff.

words.meaning: Tubu fil-ġisem li jġorr id-demm lura lejn il-qalb.
words.example: L-infermiera ħadet kampjun tad-demm minn vina f’driegħi.
words.exampleEnglish: The nurse took a blood sample from a vein in my arm.

words.meaning: Waħda mill-partijiet iebsa li jiffurmaw l-iskeletru.
words.exampleEnglish: The dog buried a bone in the garden.

words.meaning: Waħda mill-għadam mgħawweġ li jdawru s-sider u jipproteġu l-qalb u l-pulmun.
words.exampleEnglish: After the accident, the man broke a rib.

words.meaning: Il-partijiet iebsa u ppuntati li jikbru fuq ras xi annimali, bħall-mogħoż u l-baqar.
words.example: Il-muntun għandu qrun kbar u mgħawġa.
words.exampleEnglish: The ram has big curved horns.

words.meaning: Il-parti tal-ġisem ta’ xi annimali li toħroġ minn wara, fit-tarf tad-dahar.
words.example: Il-qattus għandu denb twil u iswed.
words.exampleEnglish: The cat has a long black tail.

words.meaning: Ir-ringiela ta’ għadam fid-dahar li żżomm il-ġisem wieqaf.
words.example: It-tabib qalli biex noqgħod dritt ħalli ma tweġġax is-sinsla.
words.exampleEnglish: The doctor told me to sit up straight so my spine doesn’t get hurt.

words.meaning: L-għadam tar-ras li jgħatti u jipproteġi l-moħħ.
words.exampleEnglish: In the museum we saw a dinosaur skull.

words.meaning: L-għadam tal-ħalq, ta’ fuq jew ta’ isfel, li fih jinżammu s-snien.
words.exampleEnglish: The lion has a very powerful jaw.

words.meaning: Il-parti ratba t’isfel tal-widna.
words.example: Hija libset misluta żgħira f’kull dendula.
words.exampleEnglish: She wore a small earring in each earlobe.

words.meaning: Il-parti iebsa u ppuntata tal-ħalq tal-għasafar.
words.exampleEnglish: The parrot cracked the nut with its strong beak.

words.meaning: Waħda miż-żewġ partijiet ratba madwar il-ħalq; tintuża wkoll għat-tarf ta’ tazza.
words.exampleEnglish: Because of the cold, my lower lip cracked.

words.meaning: Waħda mill-biċċiet iebsa u bojod fil-ħalq li bihom nigdmu u nomogħdu.
words.exampleEnglish: The child lost his first tooth.

words.meaning: Il-laħam roża fil-ħalq li jdawwar is-snien u jżommhom f’posthom.
words.example: Id-dentist qalli li l-ħanek kien minfuħ.
words.exampleEnglish: The dentist told me my gums were swollen.

words.meaning: Sinna wiesgħa fin-naħa ta’ wara tal-ħalq, użata biex tomgħod u titħan l-ikel.
words.example: Id-dentist qalagħli darsa li kienet tuġagħni.
words.exampleEnglish: The dentist pulled out a molar that had been hurting me.

words.meaning: Il-parti ta’ quddiem tal-għonq, u l-passaġġ minn ġewwa li minnu jgħaddu l-ikel u l-arja.
words.example: Il-gerżuma kienet tuġagħni, għalhekk xrobt te bl-għasel.
words.exampleEnglish: My throat was sore, so I drank tea with honey.

words.meaning: Il-ħofra taħt id-driegħ, fejn jiltaqa’ mal-ispalla.
words.example: It-termometru tqiegħed taħt l-abt biex jieħu t-temperatura.
words.exampleEnglish: The thermometer was placed under the armpit to take the temperature.

words.meaning: Il-kisja iebsa u ċatta fit-tarf ta’ kull saba’.
words.exampleEnglish: She cut a broken fingernail with the scissors.

words.meaning: Il-parti tal-ġisem mill-ġenbejn sas-sieq, li biha nimxu u noqogħdu weqfin.
words.example: Il-kelb kellu riġel imweġġa’ u beda jzappap.
words.exampleEnglish: The dog had an injured leg and started to limp.

words.meaning: Il-parti ta’ fuq tar-riġel, bejn il-ġenb u l-irkoppa.
words.exampleEnglish: I had a roast chicken thigh with potatoes.

words.meaning: Il-muskolu fin-naħa ta’ wara tar-riġel, bejn l-irkoppa u l-għaksa.
words.exampleEnglish: After the run, I got a cramp in my calf.

words.meaning: Il-ġog f’nofs ir-riġel, bejn il-koxxa u l-pexxun.
words.exampleEnglish: The player hurt his knee during the match.

words.meaning: Il-ġog li jgħaqqad is-sieq mar-riġel.
words.example: Lwejt l-għaksa waqt li kont niġri fuq il-blat.
words.exampleEnglish: I twisted my ankle while running on the rocks.

words.meaning: Il-parti ta’ wara tas-sieq, taħt l-għaksa.
words.exampleEnglish: The new shoe gave me a blister on my heel.

words.meaning: Il-moviment li tagħmel meta tressaq sieq waħda ’l quddiem biex timxi.
words.example: It-tarbija għamlet l-ewwel pass tagħha llum.
words.exampleEnglish: The baby took her first step today.

words.meaning: Il-kisja ħafifa li tikber fuq il-ġilda tal-għasafar u tgħinhom itiru u jżommu s-sħana.
words.exampleEnglish: The pillow was filled with soft feathers.

words.meaning: L-organu fuq is-sider tal-mara li jipproduċi l-ħalib biex jitma’ t-tarbija.
words.example: L-omm tat iż-żejża lit-tarbija meta bdiet tibki bil-ġuħ.
words.exampleEnglish: The mother breastfed the baby when it started crying with hunger.

words.meaning: Il-ponta tas-sider jew tal-bżieżel tal-annimali, li minnha joħroġ il-ħalib.
words.exampleEnglish: The calf started suckling from the cow’s teat.

words.meaning: Il-marka tonda f’nofs iż-żaqq, fejn kien imwaħħal il-kurdun taż-żokra.
words.example: It-tifel daħak meta ommu messitlu ż-żokra.
words.exampleEnglish: The child laughed when his mother touched his belly button.

words.meaning: Wieħed miż-żewġ organi li jsaffu d-demm u jagħmlu l-awrina.
words.example: It-tabib qal li kellu ġebla fil-kilwa.
words.exampleEnglish: The doctor said he had a kidney stone.

words.meaning: L-organu tal-mara li fih tikber it-tarbija qabel titwieled.
words.example: It-tarbija tikber fil-ġuf ta’ ommha għal disa’ xhur.
words.exampleEnglish: The baby grows in its mother’s womb for nine months.

words.meaning: Li għadu jgħix; mhux mejjet.
words.example: Wara t-terremot, sabu raġel ħaj taħt il-ġebel.
words.exampleEnglish: After the earthquake, they found a man alive under the rubble.

words.meaning: Il-ġisem ta’ persuna jew annimal mejjet.
words.exampleEnglish: The medical students studied a cadaver in the laboratory.

words.meaning: Il-post fl-art fejn tindifen persuna mejta.
words.example: Kull sena, il-familja tpoġġi fjuri fuq il-qabar tan-nannu.
words.exampleEnglish: Every year, the family places flowers on grandfather’s grave.

words.meaning: Qatgħa jew ħsara fil-ġilda jew fil-laħam, ħafna drabi bid-demm.
words.example: L-infermiera naddfet il-ġerħa u għattietha b’faxxa.
words.exampleEnglish: The nurse cleaned the wound and covered it with a bandage.

words.meaning: Marka blu jew vjola fuq il-ġilda, ikkawżata minn daqqa.
words.example: Wara li ħabat mal-mejda, ħarġitlu tbenġila fuq riġlu.
words.exampleEnglish: After he bumped into the table, a bruise appeared on his leg.

words.meaning: Daħħal l-ikel f’ħalqu, magħdu u belgħu; il-passat ta’ “jiekol”.
words.example: Wara l-logħba, kiel platt kbir għaġin.
words.exampleEnglish: After the match, he ate a big plate of pasta.

words.meaning: Bużżieqa żgħira fuq il-ġilda, mimlija likwidu, li ssir minn sħana jew togħrik.
words.example: Wara l-mixja twila, ħarġitli nuffata fuq sieqi.
words.exampleEnglish: After the long walk, I got a blister on my foot.

words.meaning: Marka permanenti fuq il-ġilda li tirriżulta minn ferita.
words.example: Għadu għandu ċikatriċi fuq idu minn meta waqa’ żgħir.
words.exampleEnglish: He still has a scar on his hand from when he fell as a child.

words.meaning: Sustanza li tieħu biex tfejjaq jew ittaffi marda jew uġigħ.
words.exampleEnglish: The doctor gave me medicine for the cough.

words.meaning: Sustanza li tista’ tagħmel ħsara kbira jew toqtol jekk tittieħed jew tidħol fil-ġisem.
words.example: Xi sriep għandhom velenu qawwi ħafna.
words.exampleEnglish: Some snakes have very strong venom.

words.meaning: Dak kollu li nieklu biex ngħixu u nieħdu l-enerġija.
words.example: Fil-festa kien hemm ħafna ikel u xorb.
words.exampleEnglish: At the party there was a lot of food and drink.

words.meaning: Il-ħtieġa jew ix-xewqa li tiekol.
words.example: Wara l-għawm, it-tfal kellhom ġuħ kbir.
words.exampleEnglish: After swimming, the children were very hungry.

words.meaning: Il-ħtieġa jew ix-xewqa li tixrob, speċjalment ilma.
words.example: Wara l-mixja fix-xemx, kellna għatx kbir.
words.exampleEnglish: After the walk in the sun, we were very thirsty.

words.meaning: Reċipjent fond, ġeneralment tal-metall, li fih issajjar l-ikel.
words.exampleEnglish: Grandmother cooked the soup in a big pot.

words.meaning: Reċipjent b’manku u żennuna li fih tagħli l-ilma.
words.exampleEnglish: I switched on the kettle to make tea.

words.meaning: Reċipjent ċatt bil-manku li fih taqli l-ikel.
words.exampleEnglish: She fried two eggs in the pan.

words.meaning: Reċipjent fond li fih issajjar jew isservi l-ikel, speċjalment fil-forn.
words.exampleEnglish: We cooked the baked macaroni in a large dish.

words.meaning: Reċipjent b’manku u żennuna, użat biex iżżomm u tferra’ l-ilma jew likwidi oħra.
words.example: Poġġiet buqar ilma frisk fuq il-mejda.
words.exampleEnglish: She put a jug of fresh water on the table.

words.meaning: Reċipjent żgħir b’manku li minnu tixrob te jew kafè.
words.exampleEnglish: Every morning I drink a cup of coffee.

words.meaning: Platt żgħir li fuqu tpoġġi l-kikkra.
words.exampleEnglish: The cup fell off the saucer and broke.

words.meaning: Għodda bil-manku u parti fonda żgħira, li biha tiekol jew tħawwad.
words.exampleEnglish: The child ate the soup with a big spoon.

words.meaning: L-ikel li nieklu f’ħin partikolari tal-ġurnata, bħall-kolazzjon jew l-ikla ta’ nofsinhar.
words.example: Il-Ħadd, il-familja kollha tiltaqa’ għal ikla flimkien.
words.exampleEnglish: On Sundays, the whole family gets together for a meal.

words.meaning: L-ewwel ikla tal-ġurnata, normalment tittiekel filgħodu.
words.example: Għall-kolazzjon kilt ħobża bil-butir u l-għasel.
words.exampleEnglish: For breakfast I ate bread with butter and honey.

words.meaning: L-ikla ta’ filgħaxija.
words.exampleEnglish: For dinner, Mum made baked rice.

words.meaning: Taħlita ta’ dqiq, ilma u ingredjenti oħra, li minnha jsir il-ħobż, il-pizza jew l-għaġin.
words.example: Il-furnar għaġen l-għaġina u ħalliha tikber.
words.exampleEnglish: The baker kneaded the dough and left it to rise.

words.meaning: Bini jew magna li fiha jitħan il-qamħ biex isir id-dqiq.
words.example: Il-bdiewa kienu jġibu l-qamħ fil-mitħna tar-raħal.
words.exampleEnglish: The farmers used to bring their wheat to the village mill.

words.meaning: Reċipjent iebes li fih tfarrak l-ingredjenti, bħal tewm u ħwawar.
words.exampleEnglish: He crushed the garlic and spices in the mortar.

words.meaning: Pjanti jew partijiet minnhom li nieklu, bħall-karrotti, il-patata u l-basal.
words.example: Kuljum għandna niekolu ħafna frott u ħxejjex.
words.exampleEnglish: We should eat plenty of fruit and vegetables every day.

words.meaning: Żerriegħa kbira u ċatta li tikber f’imżiewed, użata fl-ikel bħall-bigilla.
words.exampleEnglish: They are as alike as two peas in a pod.

words.meaning: Il-parti tal-pjanta li tikber mill-fjura u fiha ż-żerriegħa, bħat-tuffieħ u l-lanġas.
words.example: Wara l-ikla, dejjem niekol ftit frott.
words.exampleEnglish: After the meal, I always eat some fruit.

words.meaning: Fjuri miġbura u marbuta flimkien, ħafna drabi biex jingħataw rigal.
words.example: Ta lil martu bukkett ward għall-anniversarju.
words.exampleEnglish: He gave his wife a bouquet of roses for their anniversary.

words.meaning: Il-frotta ħelwa u ratba tas-siġra tat-tin, mimlija żerriegħa żgħira.
words.exampleEnglish: I picked a ripe fig from the tree in the garden.

words.meaning: Frotta b’qoxra iebsa li fiha qalba li tittiekel; tintuża wkoll għall-“ġewża tal-għonq”.
words.example: Kisser ġewża bil-martell biex jiekol il-qalba.
words.exampleEnglish: He cracked a walnut with the hammer to eat the kernel.

words.meaning: Il-frotta żgħira ovali tas-siġra taż-żebbuġ, li minnha jsir iż-żejt.
words.example: Qegħdet żebbuġa sewda fuq il-ħobża biż-żejt.
words.exampleEnglish: She put a black olive on the bread with oil.

words.meaning: Sustanza ratba u żejtnija fil-ġisem tal-bniedem u tal-annimali, li taħżen l-enerġija.
words.example: Qabel sajjar il-laħam, qatagħlu x-xaħam żejjed.
words.exampleEnglish: Before cooking the meat, he trimmed off the excess fat.

words.meaning: Kull likwidu li nixorbu, bħall-ilma, il-meraq jew il-kafè.
words.example: Fil-festa kien hemm xorb għal kulħadd.
words.exampleEnglish: At the party there were drinks for everyone.

words.meaning: Xarba alkoħolika magħmula mix-xgħir iffermentat u l-ħops.
words.example: Wara x-xogħol, xrob birra kiesħa mal-ħbieb.
words.exampleEnglish: After work, he drank a cold beer with his friends.

words.meaning: Il-ħwejjeġ kollha li nilbsu fuq il-ġisem.
words.example: Għall-festa kulħadd libes l-aqwa lbies tiegħu.
words.exampleEnglish: For the feast, everyone wore their best clothes.

words.meaning: Materjal minsuġ li minnu jsiru l-ħwejjeġ, il-purtieri u oġġetti oħra.
words.example: Xtrat drapp aħmar biex tħit libsa ġdida.
words.exampleEnglish: She bought red fabric to sew a new dress.

words.meaning: Fibra ratba u bajda li tikber madwar iż-żerriegħa ta’ pjanta, użata għall-ħwejjeġ.
words.exampleEnglish: In summer I prefer to wear cotton T-shirts.

words.meaning: Drapp fin u jleqq magħmul mill-ħajt tad-dudu tal-ħarir.
words.exampleEnglish: The silk scarf was very soft.

words.meaning: Għodda bil-ponta għat-titqib tal-ġilda jew tal-injam.
words.example: Is-sarraġ uża x-xifa biex jagħmel toqba fiċ-ċinturin.
words.exampleEnglish: The saddler used the awl to make a hole in the belt.

words.meaning: Ħajt twil u rqiq li jintuża biex tħit jew tinsiġ.
words.example: Daħħlet il-ħajta fil-labra u bdiet tħit il-buttuna.
words.exampleEnglish: She threaded the needle and began to sew on the button.

words.meaning: Libsa twila u wiesgħa bla kmiem, li tintlibes fuq l-ispallejn u tgħatti d-dahar.
words.exampleEnglish: The king wore a long red cloak.

words.meaning: Libsa ta’ barra bil-kmiem, li tintlibes fuq il-ħwejjeġ biex tilqa’ mill-kesħa.
words.exampleEnglish: In winter, I don’t go out without a coat.

words.meaning: Libsa tan-nisa li tiddendel mill-qadd u tgħatti l-parti t’isfel tal-ġisem.
words.example: In-nanna kienet tilbes dublett twil iswed.
words.exampleEnglish: Grandmother used to wear a long black skirt.

words.meaning: Libsa li tgħatti l-parti t’isfel tal-ġisem, b’parti separata għal kull riġel.
words.example: Libes qalziet blu u qmis bajda.
words.exampleEnglish: He wore blue trousers and a white shirt.

words.meaning: Persuna li tagħmel jew issewwi ż-żraben.
words.example: Ħadt iż-żraben għand l-iskarpan biex jibdlilhom it-takkuna.
words.exampleEnglish: I took the shoes to the cobbler to have the heels replaced.

words.meaning: Għata li tintlibes fuq ir-ras, speċjalment waħda ratba bla xifer.
words.exampleEnglish: In winter, grandfather wears a woollen cap.

words.meaning: Strixxa tal-ġilda jew tad-drapp li tintlibes madwar il-qadd biex iżżomm il-qalziet.
words.example: Il-qalziet kien kbir, għalhekk issikka ċ-ċinturin.
words.exampleEnglish: The trousers were too big, so he tightened his belt.

words.meaning: Biċċa drapp irqiq li tgħatti r-ras jew il-wiċċ.
words.exampleEnglish: The bride wore a long white veil.

words.meaning: Borża żgħira mħita f’libsa, fejn iżżomm oġġetti żgħar.
words.exampleEnglish: He put the keys in his trouser pocket.

words.meaning: Diska żgħira li tgħaddi minn toqba fil-libsa biex tagħlaqha.
words.exampleEnglish: A button fell off my shirt.

words.meaning: Oġġett li jintuża biex iżejjen post, libsa jew persuna.
words.example: Dendilna ornament tal-ħġieġ fuq is-siġra tal-Milied.
words.exampleEnglish: We hung a glass ornament on the Christmas tree.

words.meaning: Oġġetti prezzjużi li jintlibsu għaż-żina, bħal ċrieket, ġiżirani u msielet.
words.example: Żammet il-ġojjelli tagħha f’kaxxa żgħira tal-injam.
words.exampleEnglish: She kept her jewellery in a small wooden box.

words.meaning: Biċċa tonda ta’ metall (prezzjuż) li tintlibes madwar is-saba’.
words.example: Taha ċurkett tad-deheb meta talabha jiżżewġu.
words.exampleEnglish: He gave her a gold ring when he asked her to marry him.

words.meaning: Biċċa ġojjellerija li tintlibes madwar il-polz.
words.exampleEnglish: She wore a silver bracelet on her left wrist.

words.meaning: Oġġett ta’ ġojjellerija li jintlibes madwar l-għonq.
words.exampleEnglish: She had a pearl necklace around her neck.

words.meaning: Biċċa ġojjellerija li tintlibes fuq il-widna.
words.example: Tilfet misluta waqt li kienet qed tiżfen.
words.exampleEnglish: She lost an earring while she was dancing.

words.meaning: Stampa magħmula bil-lapes, pinna jew kuluri fuq karta.
words.exampleEnglish: The girl made a drawing of her grandmother's house.

words.meaning: Biċċa drapp kwadra u żgħira li tintuża biex timsaħ imnieħrek jew wiċċek.
words.example: Xejret il-maktur meta l-vapur telaq mill-port.
words.exampleEnglish: She waved her handkerchief as the ship left the harbour.

words.meaning: Għodda bi snien irqaq li biha timxat ix-xagħar.
words.exampleEnglish: Before going out, he combed his hair.

words.meaning: Għodda bil-manku u ħafna lanżit, użata għax-xagħar, għall-ħwejjeġ jew għat-tindif.
words.exampleEnglish: She ran the brush through her long hair.

words.meaning: Krema ħoxna li tindilek fuq il-ġilda biex tfejjaq jew ittaffi.
words.exampleEnglish: The pharmacist gave me an ointment for sunburn.

words.meaning: Kenn żgħir u sempliċi, ħafna drabi magħmul mill-ġebel jew mill-injam.
words.exampleEnglish: The shepherd used to sleep in a hut in the field.

words.meaning: Post fejn in-nies jgħixu għal żmien qasir f’tined jew kabini.
words.example: Matul is-sajf, l-iskawts għamlu kamp fil-kampanja.
words.exampleEnglish: During the summer, the scouts set up camp in the countryside.

words.meaning: Bieb tal-ħadid jew tal-injam f’ħajt jew f’ċint, ħafna drabi fid-daħla ta’ għalqa jew ġnien.
words.example: Il-bidwi għalaq ix-xatba biex in-nagħaġ ma joħorġux.
words.exampleEnglish: The farmer closed the gate so that the sheep would not get out.

words.meaning: Virga tal-metall li tiżżerżaq biex issakkar bieb jew tieqa.
words.example: Qabel mar jorqod, għalaq il-bieb bil-firroll.
words.exampleEnglish: Before going to bed, he bolted the door.

words.meaning: Post fil-ħajt tad-dar, taħt iċ-ċumnija, fejn jinxtegħel in-nar.
words.exampleEnglish: In the cold we sat around the fireplace.

words.meaning: Fuklar tradizzjonali tal-ġebel jew tat-tafal, bil-faħam, li kien jintuża għat-tisjir.
words.example: In-nanna kienet issajjar il-minestra fuq il-kenur.
words.exampleEnglish: Grandmother used to cook minestrone on the stove.

words.meaning: Il-pajp jew il-bini wieqaf li minnu joħroġ id-duħħan tan-nar.
words.exampleEnglish: Smoke was coming out of the house’s chimney.

words.meaning: Għata kbira u sħuna li tpoġġi fuqek fis-sodda; tfisser ukoll il-wiċċ ta’ fuq ta’ vapur.
words.example: Fil-lejl kiesaħ, poġġejt gverta oħra fuq is-sodda.
words.exampleEnglish: On the cold night, I put another blanket on the bed.

words.meaning: Reċipjent twil u miftuħ, ħafna drabi tal-ġebel, li minnu jixorbu jew jieklu l-annimali.
words.exampleEnglish: The cows were drinking from the trough.

words.meaning: Injama jew biċċa ħadid twila li żżomm is-saqaf jew l-art ta’ fuq.
words.exampleEnglish: The builder put a new beam in the ceiling.

words.meaning: Biċċa injam jew metall twila u wieqfa; tintuża wkoll fuq id-dgħajsa għall-qlugħ.
words.exampleEnglish: They raised the flag on the pole in the square.

words.meaning: Biċċa injam ċatta u twila, użata fil-bini u fl-għamara.
words.example: Il-mastrudaxxa qata’ tavla biex jagħmel xkaffa.
words.exampleEnglish: The carpenter cut a plank to make a shelf.

words.meaning: Blokk rettangolari tat-tafal moħmi, użat fil-bini.
words.exampleEnglish: The builder laid one brick on top of another.

words.meaning: Bidwi li jaħdem art li mhix tiegħu, b’kera lis-sid.
words.exampleEnglish: The tenant farmer paid the land rent to the landowner.

words.meaning: Biċċa art, ħafna drabi ħdejn dar, fejn jitkabbru fjuri u pjanti.
words.exampleEnglish: Every evening, grandfather waters the garden.

words.meaning: Ħofra twila u dejqa fl-art, ħafna drabi biex jiġri l-ilma.
words.example: Il-karozza żelqet u spiċċat fil-foss ħdejn it-triq.
words.exampleEnglish: The car skidded and ended up in the ditch by the road.

words.meaning: Għodda b’manku twil u xafra wiesgħa tal-metall, użata biex tħaffer u tiġbor il-ħamrija.
words.exampleEnglish: He dug a hole in the garden with the spade.

words.meaning: Għodda b’manku u xafra tal-ħadid, użata biex taqleb u tħaffer il-ħamrija.
words.exampleEnglish: The farmer hoed the field.

words.meaning: Għodda bi snien twal imwaħħla ma’ manku, użata biex tiġbor il-ħaxix jew tillixxa l-ħamrija.
words.exampleEnglish: He gathered the dry leaves with the rake.

words.meaning: Pjanta taċ-ċereali li miż-żerriegħa tagħha jsir id-dqiq għall-ħobż.
words.exampleEnglish: In June, farmers harvest the wheat.

words.meaning: Pjanta għolja taċ-ċereali bi ħbub sofor li jittieklu jew isiru dqiq.
words.exampleEnglish: The farmer sowed maize in the big field.

words.meaning: Ħaxix maqtugħ u mnixxef għall-użu bħala għalf għall-annimali.
words.exampleEnglish: The farmer gave the hay to the livestock in winter.

words.meaning: Ħlejqa ħajja li tikber fl-art, bħal siġra, fjura jew ħaxixa.
words.exampleEnglish: She placed a green plant on the windowsill.

words.meaning: Siġra kbira u qawwija, magħrufa għall-injam iebes tagħha u għall-ġandar.
words.exampleEnglish: In Buskett there is a very old oak tree.

words.meaning: Siġra tal-konifera ta’ dejjem ħadra, b’weraq qisu labar, li tagħmel il-koni u l-prinjol.
words.exampleEnglish: We sat in the shade of the pine trees to eat.

words.meaning: Il-frott żgħir u iebes tas-siġra tal-ballut.
words.exampleEnglish: The squirrel gathered the acorns and hid them.

words.meaning: Pjanta li l-weraq tagħha jitnixxef u jintuża biex isiru s-sigaretti u s-sigarri.
words.exampleEnglish: Grandfather used to smoke tobacco in a pipe.

words.meaning: Għodda b’zokk twil u skutella żgħira, li biha tpejjep it-tabakk.
words.exampleEnglish: The captain had a wooden pipe in his mouth.

words.meaning: Siġra twila bla friegħi, b’ġabra ta’ weraq kbar fil-quċċata, komuni fil-pajjiżi sħan.
words.example: Bqajna mimduda taħt palma fuq il-bajja.
words.exampleEnglish: We lay under a palm tree on the beach.

words.meaning: Frott bil-qoxra ħoxna u l-meraq qares jew ħelu, bħal-larinġ, il-lumi u l-mandolin.
words.example: Il-frott taċ-ċitru, bħal-larinġ u l-lumi, għandu ħafna vitamina Ċ.
words.exampleEnglish: Citrus fruit, such as oranges and lemons, contains a lot of vitamin C.

words.meaning: Frotta twila u mgħawġa b’qoxra safra u laħam ħelu u artab.
words.exampleEnglish: Every morning I eat a banana with breakfast.

words.meaning: Pjanta għolja tropikali b’zokk ħoxnin li minnu jsir iz-zokkor.
words.example: Il-kannamiela tikber fil-pajjiżi sħan u minnha jsir iz-zokkor.
words.exampleEnglish: Sugar cane grows in hot countries and sugar is made from it.

words.meaning: Attività li tagħmel, ħafna drabi bi ħlas, biex tipproduċi xi ħaġa jew tagħti servizz.
words.exampleEnglish: My father leaves for work early in the morning.

words.meaning: Ringiela ta’ ħoloq tal-metall imdaħħla f’xulxin.
words.exampleEnglish: The dog was tied to the gate with a chain.

words.meaning: Il-post fejn spag, ħabel jew ħajta jintrabtu u jinqabdu f’xulxin.
words.exampleEnglish: The fisherman tied a tight knot in the rope.

words.meaning: Għodda bħal mannara, bix-xafra mdawra lejn il-manku, użata biex issawwar l-injam.
words.exampleEnglish: The carpenter shaped the beam with the adze.

words.meaning: Oġġett li tużah biex tagħmel xogħol aktar faċli, bħal martell jew sega.
words.example: Il-mekkaniku ġab l-għodda biex isewwi l-karozza.
words.exampleEnglish: The mechanic brought his tools to repair the car.

words.meaning: Għodda b’xafra bis-snien, użata biex taqta’ l-injam jew il-metall.
words.exampleEnglish: He cut the branches of the tree with the saw.

words.meaning: Sustanza użata biex twaħħal oġġetti flimkien.
words.exampleEnglish: I stuck the pieces of the broken vase together with glue.

words.meaning: Blokk tqil tal-ħadid li fuqu l-ħaddied isawwar il-metall bil-martell.
words.example: Il-ħaddied sawwar il-vireg sħan fuq l-inkwina.
words.exampleEnglish: The blacksmith shaped the hot rods on the anvil.

words.meaning: Metall isfar u jleqq, ta’ valur kbir, użat fil-ġojjelli u fil-muniti.
words.exampleEnglish: The first-place medal was made of gold.

words.meaning: Metall abjad u jleqq, prezzjuż, użat fil-ġojjelli, fil-muniti u fl-oġġetti tad-dar.
words.exampleEnglish: Grandmother had a set of silver cutlery.

words.meaning: Metall ħamrani li jgħaddi l-elettriku tajjeb, użat fil-wajers u fil-pajpijiet.
words.exampleEnglish: Electrical wires are made of copper.

words.meaning: Metall griż, iebes u qawwi, użat ħafna fil-bini u fl-għodod.
words.exampleEnglish: The garden gate is made of iron.

words.meaning: Metall griż, tqil u artab.
words.example: Is-sajjieda jwaħħlu biċċa ċomb mal-linja biex tinżel fil-fond.
words.exampleEnglish: Fishermen attach a piece of lead to the line so that it sinks deep.

words.meaning: Folja rqiqa tal-metall miksija biex ma tissaddadx; tfisser ukoll bott tal-metall.
words.exampleEnglish: We bought a tin of tuna for the ħobż biż-żejt.

words.meaning: Ħamrija ratba u twaħħal li meta tinħema ssir iebsa, użata għall-qsari u l-briks.
words.exampleEnglish: The children made little pots out of clay.

words.meaning: Materjal iebes, trasparenti u fraġli, użat fit-twieqi u fil-fliexken.
words.exampleEnglish: The ball broke the window glass.

words.meaning: Kontenitur tal-qasab jew tal-ħajt minsuġ, bil-manki, biex iġġorr l-affarijiet.
words.exampleEnglish: Grandmother went to the market with her basket.

words.meaning: Ħjut jew spag minsuġa b’toqob, użata biex taqbad il-ħut jew biex iġġorr l-affarijiet.
words.example: Is-sajjieda tefgħu x-xibka fil-baħar filgħodu kmieni.
words.exampleEnglish: The fishermen cast the net into the sea early in the morning.

words.meaning: Oġġett jew magna li tiċċaqlaq l-arja biex tkessaħ.
words.exampleEnglish: In the heat we switched on the fan in the room.

words.meaning: Persuna li tagħmel statwi mill-ġebel, mill-injam jew minn materjal ieħor.
words.exampleEnglish: The sculptor carved a statue out of marble.

words.meaning: Figura ta’ persuna jew annimal, magħmula mill-ġebel, mill-injam jew mill-metall.
words.exampleEnglish: In the square there is a bronze statue of the poet.

words.meaning: Għodda bix-xafra fit-tarf, użata biex taqta’ u ssawwar il-ġebel jew l-injam.
words.example: L-iskultur uża l-furmatur u l-mazzola biex jaħdem il-ġebla.
words.exampleEnglish: The sculptor used the chisel and mallet to work the stone.

words.meaning: Likwidu kkulurit li jiddilek fuq ħitan jew oġġetti biex jagħtihom il-kulur.
words.exampleEnglish: We bought white paint for the bedroom walls.

words.meaning: Triq dejqa li fuqha jgħaddu n-nies bil-mixi.
words.exampleEnglish: We walked along the path to the cliff.

words.meaning: Vettura b’żewġ roti, miġbuda minn żiemel jew bagħal, użata biex iġġorr il-merkanzija.
words.example: Il-bidwi ġarr il-ħaxix lejn is-suq bil-karrettun.
words.exampleEnglish: The farmer carried the vegetables to market by cart.

words.meaning: Il-virga li fuqha ddur ir-rota.
words.exampleEnglish: The cart’s axle broke on the road.

words.meaning: Bastiment kbir li jbaħħar fuq il-baħar.
words.exampleEnglish: The Gozo ferry left from Ċirkewwa.

words.meaning: Biċċiet tal-injam marbuta flimkien biex jgħumu fuq l-ilma.
words.example: Is-superstiti għamlu ċattra biex jaslu sax-xatt.
words.exampleEnglish: The survivors built a raft to reach the shore.

words.meaning: Arblu bil-pala f’tarf wieħed, użat biex tmexxi d-dgħajsa fl-ilma.
words.exampleEnglish: The fisherman rowed the boat with the oar.

words.meaning: Muniti u karti li bihom nixtru u nbigħu l-affarijiet.
words.example: Ġemgħet il-flus biex tixtri rota ġdida.
words.exampleEnglish: She saved up money to buy a new bicycle.

words.meaning: Biċċa flus tal-metall, ġeneralment tonda.
words.exampleEnglish: He found an old coin in the garden.

words.meaning: Persuna fqira li titlob il-flus jew l-ikel lin-nies.
words.example: Tat ftit flus lit-tallab ħdejn il-knisja.
words.exampleEnglish: She gave a few coins to the beggar near the church.

words.meaning: Flus jew xi ħaġa oħra li trid tħallas lura lil xi ħadd.
words.exampleEnglish: He paid off the whole debt to the bank.

words.meaning: Il-karta li turi kemm trid tħallas, eż. f’ristorant; tfisser ukoll kont fil-bank.
words.exampleEnglish: After the meal, we asked the waiter for the bill.

words.meaning: Flus li n-nies u n-negozji jħallsu lill-gvern.
words.example: Kull sena nħallsu t-taxxa fuq id-dħul.
words.exampleEnglish: Every year we pay tax on our income.

words.meaning: Il-flus li jitħallas il-ħaddiem għax-xogħol tiegħu.
words.example: Fl-aħħar tax-xahar ħadt l-ewwel paga tiegħi.
words.exampleEnglish: At the end of the month I received my first pay.

words.meaning: Persuna li tixtri u tbigħ il-merkanzija.
words.example: Il-merkant Venezjan ġab id-drappijiet minn pajjiżi mbiegħda.
words.exampleEnglish: The Venetian merchant brought fabrics from distant lands.

words.meaning: Suq miftuħ fejn jinbiegħu ħwejjeġ u oġġetti oħra minn bankijiet.
words.exampleEnglish: On Sunday morning we went to the Valletta market.

words.meaning: L-ammont ta’ flus li trid tħallas biex tixtri xi ħaġa.
words.exampleEnglish: The price of bread went up this year.

words.meaning: F’post jew f’ħin li jiġi wara xi ħaġa oħra; mhux quddiem.
words.example: Il-kelb kien qed jistaħba wara s-sufan.
words.exampleEnglish: The dog was hiding behind the sofa.

words.meaning: Fil-parti ta’ quddiem ta’ xi ħaġa; il-kontra ta’ wara.
words.exampleEnglish: The car was parked in front of the house.

words.meaning: Fil-parti ta’ ġewwa ta’ xi ħaġa, bħal kamra jew kaxxa; il-kontra ta’ barra.
words.exampleEnglish: Because of the rain, the children played inside.

words.meaning: Mhux ġewwa bini jew xi ħaġa; fil-miftuħ.
words.exampleEnglish: In summer we eat outside in the yard.

words.meaning: F’post aktar baxx minn xi ħaġa oħra.
words.exampleEnglish: The cat fell asleep under the table.

words.meaning: F’post ogħla minn xi ħaġa oħra, jew imqiegħed fuq wiċċha.
words.exampleEnglish: I put the books on the shelf.

words.meaning: Parti tal-ispazju jew żona fejn tinsab jew isseħħ xi ħaġa.
words.example: Dan huwa post sabiħ għal piknik.
words.exampleEnglish: This is a lovely place for a picnic.

words.meaning: Dak li jibqa’ wara li l-bqija tittiekel, tintuża jew tinqered.
words.example: L-arkeoloġi sabu l-fdal ta’ tempju antik.
words.exampleEnglish: The archaeologists found the remains of an ancient temple.

words.meaning: L-ogħla parti ta’ xi ħaġa, bħal muntanja jew siġra.
words.example: Wara mixja twila, wasalna fil-quċċata tal-għolja.
words.exampleEnglish: After a long walk, we reached the top of the hill.

words.meaning: L-iktar parti baxxa ta’ xi ħaġa, bħal ta’ reċipjent jew tal-baħar.
words.exampleEnglish: The ring fell to the bottom of the sea.

words.meaning: L-aħħar parti jew il-ponta ta’ xi ħaġa.
words.exampleEnglish: Our house is at the end of the street.

words.meaning: It-tarf ta’ xi ħaġa, bħal rdum jew mejda, fejn tispiċċa.
words.example: Toqgħodx fuq ix-xifer tal-irdum, għax perikoluż.
words.exampleEnglish: Don’t stand on the edge of the cliff, it’s dangerous.

words.meaning: Waħda mill-partijiet ta’ xi ħaġa, fuq il-lemin jew ix-xellug, jew waħda mill-uċuħ tagħha.
words.example: Il-ħanut jinsab fuq in-naħa l-oħra tat-triq.
words.exampleEnglish: The shop is on the other side of the street.

words.meaning: Il-parti li tinsab l-istess distanza minn żewġ truf; tfisser ukoll waħda minn żewġ partijiet indaqs.
words.exampleEnglish: He placed the flower in the middle of the table.

words.meaning: Id-direzzjoni fejn titla’ x-xemx.
words.exampleEnglish: Every morning the sun rises in the east.

words.meaning: Id-direzzjoni fejn tinżel ix-xemx.
words.example: Mill-gallarija naraw ix-xemx tinżel lejn il-punent.
words.exampleEnglish: From the balcony we watch the sun set in the west.

words.meaning: Id-direzzjoni lejn il-Pol tat-Tramuntana; ukoll ir-riħ kiesaħ li jonfoħ minn din in-naħa.
words.exampleEnglish: The compass needle always points north.

words.meaning: Biċċa metall jew plastik mgħawġa, użata biex iddendel jew taqbad xi ħaġa.
words.example: Dendilt il-kowt fuq il-ganċ wara l-bieb.
words.exampleEnglish: I hung the coat on the hook behind the door.

words.meaning: Il-post fejn jiltaqgħu żewġ ħitan jew żewġ toroq.
words.exampleEnglish: The boy sat in the corner of the room reading.

words.meaning: Sinjal magħmul minn żewġ linji li jaqsmu lil xulxin; is-simbolu ewlieni tal-Kristjaneżmu.
words.exampleEnglish: There is an iron cross on top of the belfry.

words.meaning: Forma b’erba’ naħat indaqs u erba’ angoli retti.
words.example: It-tifel pinġa kwadru u ċirku fuq il-karta.
words.exampleEnglish: The child drew a square and a circle on the paper.

words.meaning: Forma tonda u ċatta, li t-truf kollha tagħha huma l-istess distanza miċ-ċentru.
words.exampleEnglish: The children sat in a circle around the teacher.

words.meaning: Oġġett tond, ħafna drabi minfuħ bl-arja, użat fil-logħob.
words.exampleEnglish: The children played with the ball in the square.

words.meaning: Marka twila u rqiqa li tgħaqqad żewġ punti.
words.exampleEnglish: The teacher drew a straight line with the ruler.

words.meaning: Ftuħ jew vojt f’xi ħaġa solida.
words.exampleEnglish: There was a hole in the sock.

words.meaning: In-numru 2.
words.exampleEnglish: How many cats do you have? I have two.

words.meaning: In-numru 3.
words.exampleEnglish: The match ended three to one.

words.meaning: In-numru 4.
words.exampleEnglish: Two and two make four.

words.meaning: In-numru 5.
words.exampleEnglish: The shop closes at five in the evening.

words.meaning: In-numru 6.
words.exampleEnglish: I woke up at six in the morning.

words.meaning: In-numru 7.
words.exampleEnglish: The music lesson starts at seven.

words.meaning: In-numru 8.
words.exampleEnglish: The lesson starts at eight.

words.meaning: In-numru 9.
words.exampleEnglish: The workers start work at nine.

words.meaning: In-numru 10.
words.exampleEnglish: You deserve ten out of ten!

words.meaning: In-numru 11.
words.exampleEnglish: The first team’s players were eleven.

words.meaning: In-numru 12.
words.exampleEnglish: The clock struck twelve.

words.meaning: In-numru 20.
words.exampleEnglish: The books cost me twenty euro.

words.meaning: In-numru 100.
words.exampleEnglish: Great-grandmother turned a hundred.

words.meaning: In-numru 1000.
words.example: Dan il-kastell għandu kważi elf sena.
words.exampleEnglish: This castle is almost a thousand years old.

words.meaning: Numru jew ammont kbir.
words.exampleEnglish: There were many people at the feast.

words.meaning: Numru jew ammont żgħir; mhux ħafna.
words.exampleEnglish: Add a little salt to the food.

words.meaning: Daqs kemm hemm bżonn; la wisq u lanqas ftit.
words.exampleEnglish: We have enough food for everyone.

words.meaning: Grupp kbir ta’ nies miġbura flimkien.
words.exampleEnglish: A large crowd gathered in the square for the concert.

words.meaning: Xejn aktar; mhux ħlief.
words.exampleEnglish: I have only one euro in my pocket.

words.meaning: Żewġ affarijiet simili jew identiċi meħuda flimkien.
words.exampleEnglish: I bought a new pair of shoes.

words.meaning: It-tul li fih jgħaddu l-ġrajjiet, imkejjel f’sekondi, minuti, sigħat u snin.
words.example: Ma kellix żmien biżżejjed biex nispiċċa l-eżami.
words.exampleEnglish: I didn’t have enough time to finish the exam.

words.meaning: Wara l-ħin mistenni, jew lejn l-aħħar ta’ perjodu ta’ żmien.
words.exampleEnglish: He arrived late for work because of the traffic.

words.meaning: Fil-preżent; f’dan iż-żmien.
words.exampleEnglish: I want to go home now.

words.meaning: Bla dewmien; f’daqqa.
words.exampleEnglish: When we heard the alarm, we left immediately.

words.meaning: F’kull ħin; mingħajr waqfien.
words.exampleEnglish: Grandmother always welcomes us with a smile.

words.meaning: Ħafna drabi, b’intervalli qosra bejn l-okkażjonijiet.
words.exampleEnglish: We often go to the beach in summer.

words.meaning: F’ċerti okkażjonijiet, jew f’ċerti ċirkostanzi, iżda mhux dejjem.
words.exampleEnglish: Sometimes I walk to work instead of driving.

words.meaning: Fi ftit ħin; fil-futur qarib.
words.exampleEnglish: Wait a little, I’ll be there soon.

words.meaning: Jintuża biex juri kemm għadda żmien minn meta seħħet jew bdiet xi ħaġa.
words.exampleEnglish: I haven’t seen him for two years.

words.meaning: Perjodu ta’ 24 siegħa, jew il-parti tiegħu meta jkun hemm id-dawl.
words.exampleEnglish: It was a lovely sunny day.

words.meaning: Il-ħin fil-bidu tal-ġurnata meta d-dawl jibda jidher, ftit qabel titla’ x-xemx.
words.exampleEnglish: The fishermen went out in the boat at dawn.

words.meaning: Il-parti tal-ġurnata mis-sebħ sa nofsinhar.
words.example: F’għodwa sabiħa ta’ Mejju morna nimxu fil-kampanja.
words.exampleEnglish: One fine May morning we went walking in the countryside.

words.meaning: Il-parti tal-ġurnata meta d-dawl jibda jonqos u jasal il-lejl; tfisser ukoll lejl wieħed.
words.exampleEnglish: We spent a lovely evening with friends.

words.meaning: Il-jum li jiġi wara llum.
words.exampleEnglish: Tomorrow we are going to Gozo.

words.meaning: Il-jum ta’ wara għada.
words.exampleEnglish: The exam isn’t tomorrow, but the day after tomorrow.

words.meaning: L-iktar staġun kiesaħ tas-sena, bejn il-ħarifa u r-rebbiegħa.
words.exampleEnglish: In winter we wear warm clothes.

words.meaning: L-istaġun bejn ix-xitwa u s-sajf, meta jiftħu l-fjuri.
words.exampleEnglish: In spring the fields fill with flowers.

words.meaning: L-iktar staġun sħun tas-sena, bejn ir-rebbiegħa u l-ħarifa.
words.example: Kull sajf immorru nqattgħu ġimgħa Għawdex.
words.exampleEnglish: Every summer we spend a week in Gozo.

words.meaning: L-istaġun bejn is-sajf u x-xitwa, meta jibda jiksaħ u jaqgħu l-weraq.
words.exampleEnglish: In autumn the first rain starts to fall.

words.meaning: Waħda mill-erba’ partijiet tas-sena: ir-rebbiegħa, is-sajf, il-ħarifa u x-xitwa.
words.exampleEnglish: Spring is my favourite season.

words.meaning: Dak li nisimgħu bil-widnejn.
words.exampleEnglish: At night I heard a strange noise in the kitchen.

words.meaning: Nuqqas ta’ ħsejjes jew storbju.
words.exampleEnglish: Quiet is needed in the library.

words.meaning: Il-parti spiritwali tal-bniedem, li skont ħafna reliġjonijiet tibqa’ tgħix wara l-mewt.
words.exampleEnglish: They prayed for grandfather’s soul.

words.meaning: Xi ħaġa pożittiva li tiġri lil xi ħadd b’kumbinazzjoni.
words.exampleEnglish: Luckily, we found the wallet I had lost.

words.meaning: Dwejjaq kbira minħabba telf jew xi ħaġa ħażina li ġrat.
words.example: Il-mewt tal-kelb ġabet niket kbir fil-familja.
words.exampleEnglish: The death of the dog brought great sorrow to the family.

words.meaning: Għarfien profond tat-tbatija ta’ ħaddieħor, flimkien max-xewqa li ttaffiha.
words.example: Kellu ħniena mill-qattus abbandunat u ħadu d-dar.
words.exampleEnglish: He took pity on the abandoned cat and took it home.

words.meaning: Qatra ta’ likwidu prodotta mill-għajnejn mill-biki jew irritazzjoni.
words.example: Demgħa niżlet fuq ħaddha meta qrat l-ittra.
words.exampleEnglish: A tear ran down her cheek when she read the letter.

words.meaning: Sentiment qawwi ta’ korla meta xi ħaġa ma togħġobniex jew tidher inġusta.
words.exampleEnglish: In anger, he threw the books on the floor.

words.meaning: Sentiment ta’ skuntentizza meta xi ħadd ieħor ikollu dak li tixtieq int.
words.example: L-għira ma ħallietux jifraħ bis-suċċess ta’ ħuh.
words.exampleEnglish: Envy stopped him from being happy at his brother’s success.

words.meaning: Sentiment ta’ skumdità meta wieħed jagħmel xi ħaġa ħażina jew ridikola.
words.exampleEnglish: He blushed with embarrassment.

words.meaning: Sitwazzjoni li fiha tista’ tiġri ħsara jew korriment.
words.example: Is-sinjal iwissi li hemm periklu ta’ blat jaqa’.
words.exampleEnglish: The sign warns that there is a danger of falling rocks.

words.meaning: L-att li tqarraq bin-nies jew tgħidilhom il-gideb biex tieħu vantaġġ.
words.example: Skoprew il-qerq tal-bejjiegħ u ma xtrawx.
words.exampleEnglish: They discovered the seller’s deceit and did not buy.

words.meaning: Ir-responsabbiltà ta’ xi ħaġa ħażina li ġrat.
words.example: Mhux tort tiegħi jekk wasalna tard.
words.exampleEnglish: It’s not my fault if we arrived late.

words.meaning: Xi ħaġa li ssir ħażin, mingħajr ma trid.
words.exampleEnglish: I made a mistake in the first sum.

words.meaning: Ir-responsabbiltà għal xi ħaġa ħażina, jew is-sentiment li għamilt ħażin.
words.exampleEnglish: The blame fell on the driver of the car.

words.meaning: Kliem sabiħ li jesprimi approvazzjoni jew ammirazzjoni.
words.exampleEnglish: The teacher praised the whole class.

words.meaning: Pjan jew kunċett li huwa ffurmat u jeżisti fil-moħħ bħala riżultat ta’ attività mentali.
words.exampleEnglish: I had a good idea for the project.

words.meaning: Dak li wieħed għandu f’moħħu li jagħmel.
words.example: L-intenzjoni tiegħi hi li nispiċċa kmieni.
words.exampleEnglish: My intention is to finish early.

words.meaning: Proċess legali quddiem il-qorti; tfisser ukoll dak li jġib xi effett.
words.exampleEnglish: They filed a lawsuit against the company.

words.meaning: Nuqqas ta’ ċertezza dwar xi ħaġa.
words.example: Għandi dubju jekk il-ħanut hux miftuħ illum.
words.exampleEnglish: I have doubts whether the shop is open today.

words.meaning: Ħtieġa ta’ xi ħaġa li m’għandekx.
words.exampleEnglish: I need your help.

words.meaning: Il-mod kif persuna ġġib ruħha ma’ ħaddieħor.
words.exampleEnglish: The boy has very good manners.

words.meaning: Kelma li tistaqsi għar-raġuni ta’ xi ħaġa; tintuża wkoll biex tagħti r-raġuni.
words.exampleEnglish: Why didn’t you come to the party?

words.meaning: Kelma li tgħaqqad żewġ għażliet.
words.exampleEnglish: Would you like tea or coffee?

words.meaning: Kelma użata biex turi qbil jew affermazzjoni ta’ xi ħaġa.
words.example: Meta staqsejtu jekk iridx jiġi, qal iva.
words.exampleEnglish: When I asked him if he wanted to come, he said yes.

words.meaning: Kelma li tistaqsi b’liema mod issir xi ħaġa.
words.exampleEnglish: How do you make baked macaroni?

words.meaning: Kelma li tistaqsi dwar in-numru jew l-ammont ta’ xi ħaġa.
words.exampleEnglish: How much does this book cost?

words.meaning: Kelma li tistaqsi dwar il-ħin.
words.exampleEnglish: What time does Mass start?

words.meaning: Kelma li tistaqsi dwar il-post.
words.exampleEnglish: Where is the new school?

words.meaning: Kelma li tistaqsi liema persuna jew nies.
words.exampleEnglish: Who knocked at the door?

words.meaning: Il-ħoss li jagħmel il-bniedem meta jitkellem jew ikanta.
words.exampleEnglish: The singer has a very beautiful voice.

words.meaning: Kliem li persuna tgħid quddiem grupp ta’ nies, ħafna drabi f’okkażjoni speċjali.
words.exampleEnglish: The President gave a speech at the opening of the exhibition.

words.meaning: Is-sistema ta’ kliem u regoli li jintużaw minn poplu biex jikkomunika.
words.example: Il-Malti huwa l-lingwa nazzjonali ta’ Malta.
words.exampleEnglish: Maltese is the national language of Malta.

words.meaning: Ħoss jew grupp ta’ ittri li għandu tifsira u jintuża fil-lingwa.
words.exampleEnglish: The baby said her first word.

words.meaning: Il-kelma li biha nsejħu persuna, annimal, post jew ħaġa.
words.exampleEnglish: They chose a beautiful name for the baby.

words.meaning: Persuna li tikteb il-poeżija.
words.example: Dun Karm huwa magħruf bħala l-poeta nazzjonali ta’ Malta.
words.exampleEnglish: Dun Karm is known as Malta’s national poet.

words.meaning: Strument mużikali tar-riħ li jindaqq billi tonfoħ minn toqba u tagħlaq toqob oħra bis-swaba’.
words.exampleEnglish: The girl plays the flute in the school band.

words.meaning: Strument mużikali tar-ram li tonfoħ fih biex jagħti ħoss qawwi.
words.exampleEnglish: In the procession we heard the band’s trumpet.

words.meaning: Strument żgħir tal-injam li jagħmel storbju qawwi meta ddawru.
words.exampleEnglish: The child made a lot of noise with the rattle.

words.meaning: Territorju b’gvern, liġijiet u poplu tiegħu.
words.exampleEnglish: Malta is a small country in the Mediterranean.

words.meaning: Grupp ta’ djar u bini ieħor, bħal knisja, skola u xi ħwienet, li huwa iżgħar minn belt, ġeneralment fil-kampanja.
words.example: Dan il-villaġġ għandu knisja antika u pjazza sabiħa.
words.exampleEnglish: This village has an ancient church and a lovely square.

words.meaning: Il-linja li tifred żewġ pajjiżi jew żewġ żoni.
words.exampleEnglish: They stopped us at the border to check our passports.

words.meaning: In-nies kollha li jgħixu f’pajjiż jew li għandhom l-istess storja u kultura.
words.example: Il-poplu Malti jiċċelebra Jum il-Ħelsien f’Marzu.
words.exampleEnglish: The Maltese people celebrate Freedom Day in March.

words.meaning: Persuna li tmexxi grupp, tribù jew organizzazzjoni.
words.exampleEnglish: The tribal chief made the final decision.

words.meaning: Għasluġ tal-injam jew tal-metall li jgħinek timxi.
words.exampleEnglish: Grandfather walks with a walking stick.

words.meaning: Raġel li jaħkem pajjiż, ħafna drabi b’dritt li jirtu mill-familja.
words.exampleEnglish: The king lived in a large palace.

words.meaning: Mara li taħkem pajjiż, jew il-mara tas-sultan.
words.exampleEnglish: The queen wore a golden crown.

words.meaning: Persuna minn familja aristokratika, b’titlu bħal konti jew markiż.
words.exampleEnglish: The nobleman lived in a palace in Mdina.

words.meaning: Persuna li tappartjeni għal pajjiż u għandha d-drittijiet u d-dmirijiet tiegħu.
words.example: Kull ċittadin għandu d-dritt li jivvota.
words.exampleEnglish: Every citizen has the right to vote.

words.meaning: Persuna li għandha xi ħaġa jew li tħaddem lil ħaddieħor.
words.exampleEnglish: The shop owner opened early.

words.meaning: Persuna li kienet proprjetà ta’ ħaddieħor u mġiegħla taħdem bla ħlas.
words.example: Fiż-żminijiet antiki, l-iskjav ma kellux libertà.
words.exampleEnglish: In ancient times, the slave had no freedom.

words.meaning: Persuna li taqdi lil ħaddieħor, speċjalment fid-dar.
words.exampleEnglish: The servant served the food to the guests.

words.meaning: Persuna jew grupp li hu kontrik u jrid jagħmillek il-ħsara.
words.exampleEnglish: The cat is the mouse’s enemy.

words.meaning: Persuna minn pajjiż ieħor jew li ma nafuhiex.
words.example: Stranġier staqsieni fejn hu t-terminus tal-karozzi tal-linja.
words.exampleEnglish: A foreigner asked me where the bus terminus is.

words.meaning: Persuna li tiġi tżur jew tieħu sehem f’okkażjoni għax tkun ġiet mistiedna.
words.exampleEnglish: Every guest took a piece of cake.

words.meaning: Ħaġa li ssir regolarment minn persuna jew minn komunità, għax hekk imdorrijin.
words.example: Hija drawwa Maltija li l-familja tiltaqa’ għall-ikla tal-Ħadd.
words.exampleEnglish: It is a Maltese custom for the family to meet for Sunday lunch.

words.meaning: Diskussjoni qawwija bejn żewġ persuni jew aktar li ma jaqblux.
words.exampleEnglish: The neighbours had an argument about parking.

words.meaning: Ftehim sigriet bejn nies biex jagħmlu xi ħaġa ħażina.
words.exampleEnglish: The guards discovered the plot against the king.

words.meaning: Ġlied bl-armi bejn pajjiżi jew gruppi.
words.example: In-nannu kien jirrakkonta stejjer mit-Tieni Gwerra Dinjija.
words.exampleEnglish: Grandfather used to tell stories from the Second World War.

words.meaning: Żmien jew stat mingħajr gwerra jew ġlied.
words.example: Wara snin ta’ gwerra, finalment waslet il-paċi.
words.exampleEnglish: After years of war, peace finally came.

words.meaning: Forza militari kbira ta’ pajjiż, li tiġġieled l-aktar fuq l-art.
words.exampleEnglish: The French army took Malta in 1798.

words.meaning: Persuna li sservi fl-armata.
words.exampleEnglish: The soldier stood guard in front of the palace.

words.meaning: Oġġetti użati biex tattakka jew tiddefendi ruħek, bħal xwabel jew snieter.
words.exampleEnglish: The soldiers placed their weapons in the armoury.

words.meaning: Għasluġ tqil b’ras ħoxna, użat bħala arma jew biex tħabbat.
words.exampleEnglish: The builder knocked down the wall with the sledgehammer.

words.meaning: Strixxa żgħira tal-ġilda b’żewġ spagi, użata biex titfa’ l-ġebel ’il bogħod.
words.example: David qatel lil Golija b’ħaġra miż-żbandola.
words.exampleEnglish: David killed Goliath with a stone from his sling.

words.meaning: Arma magħmula minn injam imgħawweġ u spag, li biha tispara l-vleġeġ.
words.example: Il-kaċċatur ġibed il-qaws u spara vleġġa.
words.exampleEnglish: The hunter drew the bow and shot an arrow.

words.meaning: Virga rqiqa bil-ponta li tisparaha bil-qaws.
words.exampleEnglish: The arrow hit the centre of the target.

words.meaning: Arma b’manku twil tal-injam u ponta tal-ħadid, użata biex titfagħha jew tniggeż.
words.example: Il-kavallier kien armat b’lanza u tarka.
words.exampleEnglish: The knight was armed with a lance and shield.

words.meaning: Arma b’xafra twila tal-metall u manku.
words.exampleEnglish: The knight raised his sword before the enemy.

words.meaning: Arma tan-nar b’kanna twila, li tispara l-balal jew l-iskrataċ.
words.exampleEnglish: The hunter cleaned his shotgun before the season.

words.meaning: Ħwejjeġ li jilbsu s-suldati biex jipproteġu lilhom infushom waqt il-ġlieda. Storikament magħmul minn ġilda jew metall, illum jintużaw materjali speċjali bħall-kevlar.
words.exampleEnglish: The knights wore iron armour.

words.meaning: Pjanċa kbira tal-metall jew tal-injam li żżommha f’idek biex tipproteġi ruħek mid-daqqiet.
words.exampleEnglish: The soldier blocked the blow with his shield.

words.meaning: Bini kbir u msaħħaħ b’ħitan ħoxnin, magħmul biex jiddefendi post.
words.example: Il-Forti Sant’Anġlu huwa fortizza antika fil-Birgu.
words.exampleEnglish: Fort St Angelo is an ancient fortress in Birgu.

words.meaning: Bini għoli u dejjaq, li ħafna drabi kien jintuża biex tara ’l bogħod.
words.example: Mit-torri tal-għassa stajna naraw il-kosta kollha.
words.exampleEnglish: From the watchtower we could see the whole coast.

words.meaning: Tmiem ta’ ġlieda jew kompetizzjoni li spiċċat f’suċċess.
words.exampleEnglish: The team celebrated the victory in the square.

words.meaning: Meta titlef logħba, kompetizzjoni jew ġlieda.
words.exampleEnglish: After the defeat, the players were sad.

words.meaning: Meta xi ħadd jaqbad lil xi ħadd ieħor b’vjolenza jew bil-kliem.
words.exampleEnglish: The army launched an attack at night.

words.meaning: Persuna miżmuma fil-ħabs jew maqbuda mill-għadu.
words.exampleEnglish: The prisoner escaped from prison.

words.meaning: Persuna li tipproteġi jew tgħasses fuq xi ħaġa.
words.exampleEnglish: The keeper closed the garden gates at five.

words.meaning: Meta tieħu xi ħaġa li mhix tiegħek mingħajr permess.
words.exampleEnglish: The police are investigating the theft from the shop.

words.meaning: Ganċ tal-metall għall-qbid tal-ħut.
words.example: Waħħal il-lixka mas-sunnara u tefa’ l-linja.
words.exampleEnglish: He fixed the bait on the hook and cast the line.

words.meaning: Tip ta’ xibka tas-sajd.
words.exampleEnglish: The fishermen set the net at dusk.

words.meaning: Kaxxa jew qoffa tal-qasab jew tal-wajer, b’daħla dejqa, użata biex jinqabdu l-ħut ħajjin.
words.exampleEnglish: The fisherman pulled up the fish trap full of fish.

words.meaning: Ikel li tpoġġi fuq is-sunnara jew f’nassa biex tħajjar il-ħut jew l-annimali.
words.exampleEnglish: He used worms as bait.

words.meaning: Apparat għall-qbid u ż-żamma tal-annimali.
words.exampleEnglish: The mouse was caught in the trap.

words.meaning: Regola magħmula mill-gvern li kulħadd irid jobdi.
words.exampleEnglish: The law requires drivers to wear a seatbelt.

words.meaning: Id-deċiżjoni tal-qorti jew tal-imħallef dwar każ.
words.exampleEnglish: The judge delivered the judgment after two weeks.

words.meaning: Persuna li tmexxi l-qorti u tiddeċiedi l-każijiet.
words.exampleEnglish: The judge heard all the witnesses.

words.meaning: Persuna li tagħmel ilment jew tibda kawża fil-qorti.
words.example: Il-kwerelant ta x-xhieda tiegħu quddiem il-qorti.
words.exampleEnglish: The complainant gave his testimony before the court.

words.meaning: Il-persuna li kontriha ssir kawża ċivili.
words.exampleEnglish: The defendant contested the plaintiff’s claim.

words.meaning: Persuna li rat jew semgħet xi ħaġa u tista’ tixhed dwarha.
words.exampleEnglish: The witness said he saw the accident.

words.meaning: Wegħda solenni li tgħid il-verità jew li tagħmel xi ħaġa.
words.exampleEnglish: The witness took the oath before testifying.

words.meaning: Kastig mogħti lil min jikser il-liġi.
words.example: L-imħallef ta piena ta’ sentejn ħabs.
words.exampleEnglish: The judge gave a sentence of two years in prison.

words.meaning: Somma flus li trid tħallas bħala kastig talli ksirt regola jew liġi.
words.example: Ħadt multa talli pparkjajt f’post ħażin.
words.exampleEnglish: I got a fine for parking in the wrong place.

words.meaning: Persuna li tisraq.
words.exampleEnglish: The thief came in through the window at night.

words.meaning: It-twemmin f’Alla jew f’allat, u l-prattiki u t-talb li jakkumpanjawh.
words.exampleEnglish: In this school they also teach religion.

words.meaning: Dar ta’ qima u attivitajiet spiritwali.
words.example: It-tempju ta’ Ħaġar Qim huwa eluf ta’ snin qadim.
words.exampleEnglish: The Ħaġar Qim temple is thousands of years old.

words.meaning: Il-mejda fil-knisja fejn issir il-quddiesa.
words.exampleEnglish: The priest stood before the altar.

words.meaning: Raġel ordnat fil-Knisja li jqaddes u jamministra s-sagramenti.
words.exampleEnglish: The priest began Mass at seven.

words.meaning: Skont ħafna reliġjonijiet, il-post ta’ hena eterna fejn imorru r-rwieħ tat-tajbin wara l-mewt.
words.example: Jemmen li n-nanna issa qiegħda l-ġenna.
words.exampleEnglish: He believes that grandmother is now in heaven.

words.meaning: F’diversi reliġjonijiet, il-post fejn jingħad li jmorru l-midinbin wara l-mewt.
words.example: Fil-pitturi qodma, l-infern jidher mimli nirien.
words.exampleEnglish: In old paintings, hell appears full of flames.

words.meaning: Spirtu ħażin; fil-Kristjaneżmu, l-għadu ta’ Alla.
words.exampleEnglish: In the story, the devil tried to trick the villagers.

words.meaning: Qawwa misterjuża li tagħmel affarijiet li jidhru impossibbli, jew it-tricks ta’ maġiku.
words.example: Il-maġiku għamel il-maġija u l-fenek għeb.
words.exampleEnglish: The magician performed magic and the rabbit vanished.

words.meaning: Persuna li tipprattika l-maġija.
words.example: Fil-ħrafa, is-saħħar biddel lill-prinċep fi żrinġ.
words.exampleEnglish: In the fairy tale, the sorcerer turned the prince into a frog.

words.meaning: Marka, ġest jew oġġett li jwassal tagħrif jew juri direzzjoni.
words.example: Is-sinjal fit-triq uriena li kellna nduru lejn ix-xellug.
words.exampleEnglish: The road sign showed us that we had to turn left.

words.meaning: Trankwill u mingħajr ħafna moviment, riħ jew mewġ.
words.example: Il-baħar kien kalm u d-dgħajsa mxiet bla skossi.
words.exampleEnglish: The sea was calm and the boat moved without jolting.

words.meaning: B’ħafna moviment u mewġ qawwi, speċjalment meta jingħad għall-baħar.
words.example: Il-baħar kien mqalleb, għalhekk id-dgħajjes baqgħu fil-port.
words.exampleEnglish: The sea was rough, so the boats remained in the harbour.

words.meaning: Sinjal miktub li jifforma parti mill-alfabett, jew messaġġ miktub li jintbagħat lil xi ħadd.
words.example: Ktibt ittra lil ħabib tiegħi u poġġejtha f’envelopp.
words.exampleEnglish: I wrote a letter to my friend and put it in an envelope.

words.meaning: L-omm tan-nanna jew tan-nannu tiegħek.
words.exampleEnglish: Our great-grandmother turned ninety.

words.meaning: Il-missier tan-nanna jew tan-nannu tiegħek.
words.exampleEnglish: Great-grandfather was a fisherman in Marsaxlokk.

words.meaning: Il-mara li raġel ikun miżżewweġ magħha.
words.exampleEnglish: The mayor's wife opened the art exhibition.

words.meaning: Ir-raġel li mara tkun miżżewġa miegħu.
words.example: Iż-żewġ tagħha jsajjar kull nhar ta’ Ħadd.
words.exampleEnglish: Her husband cooks every Sunday.

words.meaning: Mara li se tiżżewweġ jew li għadha kif iżżewġet.
words.exampleEnglish: The bride entered the church in a long dress.

words.meaning: Raġel li se jiżżewweġ jew li għadu kif iżżewweġ.
words.exampleEnglish: The groom waited in front of the altar.

words.meaning: Ħu l-mara jew ir-raġel tiegħek, jew ir-raġel ta’ oħtek.
words.exampleEnglish: My brother-in-law helped me paint the house.

words.meaning: Oħt il-mara jew ir-raġel tiegħek, jew il-mara ta’ ħuk.
words.exampleEnglish: My sister-in-law brought an almond tart for lunch.

words.meaning: Tifla jew mara li hija bint iz-ziju jew iz-zija tiegħek.
words.exampleEnglish: My female cousin lives in Australia.

words.meaning: Ħut u ħuti: it-tfal kollha tal-istess ġenituri.
words.exampleEnglish: The siblings shared a room until they grew up.

words.meaning: It-tfal ta’ omm u missier, kemm subien kif ukoll bniet.
words.exampleEnglish: All the children came for the anniversary.

words.meaning: Raġel li jakkumpanja t-tarbija fil-magħmudija jew fil-griżma.
words.exampleEnglish: My godfather gave me a watch for my confirmation.

words.meaning: Mara li takkumpanja t-tarbija fil-magħmudija jew fil-griżma.
words.exampleEnglish: The godmother held the baby at the baptism.

words.meaning: Ir-rabta uffiċjali bejn żewġ persuni li jiżżewġu.
words.exampleEnglish: The grandparents' marriage lasted fifty years.

words.meaning: Il-mument meta tarbija toħroġ għad-dinja.
words.exampleEnglish: The birth of the baby delighted the whole family.

words.meaning: Iż-żmien kollu li persuna jew ħlejqa tgħix.
words.example: In-nannu għex ħajja twila u kwieta.
words.exampleEnglish: Grandfather lived a long and quiet life.

words.meaning: Meta l-ġisem jieqaf jgħix għal dejjem.
words.exampleEnglish: The dog's death saddened the children.

words.meaning: In-numru ta’ snin li persuna ilha ħajja.
words.example: Fl-għomor ta’ tmien snin tgħallem jgħum.
words.exampleEnglish: At the age of eight he learnt to swim.

words.meaning: Raġel jew tifel li jaqsam miegħek xogħol, logħba jew vjaġġ.
words.exampleEnglish: My project partner wrote the report.

words.meaning: Mara jew tifla li taqsam miegħek xogħol, logħba jew vjaġġ.
words.exampleEnglish: My classmate lends me her pencil.

words.meaning: Persuna li kibret għal kollox u m’għadhiex tifel jew tifla.
words.example: Kull tifel irid ikun ma’ adult fil-pixxina.
words.exampleEnglish: Every child must be with an adult at the pool.

words.meaning: Persuna li għandha ħafna snin.
words.exampleEnglish: The elderly man sat enjoying the sun.

words.meaning: Bniedem, raġel jew mara, tifel jew tifla.
words.exampleEnglish: Each person took a ticket at the door.

words.meaning: Persuna li ssuq karozza, xarabank jew vettura oħra.
words.exampleEnglish: The bus driver greeted the children.

words.meaning: Persuna li tivvjaġġa f’vettura imma ma ssuqhiex.
words.exampleEnglish: Every passenger must wear the seatbelt.

words.meaning: Persuna li żżur pajjiż jew post għall-gost jew biex titgħallem.
words.exampleEnglish: A tourist asked me where Mdina is.

words.meaning: Persuna li tistudja fi skola, kulleġġ jew università.
words.exampleEnglish: The student sat studying in the library.

words.meaning: Mara li tgħallem suġġett jew ħila lil studenti.
words.exampleEnglish: The teacher read a story to the class.

words.meaning: Persuna li taħdem għal xi ħadd ieħor bi ħlas.
words.exampleEnglish: Every worker wore a helmet on site.

words.meaning: Persuna li tixtri jew tuża s-servizzi ta’ negozju.
words.exampleEnglish: The customer paid and left happy.

words.meaning: Persuna li tbigħ oġġetti, spiss fis-suq jew fit-triq.
words.exampleEnglish: The vegetable seller shouted out the prices.

words.meaning: Persuna b’imnieħer aħmar u ħwejjeġ kbar li tidħaq lin-nies.
words.example: Il-buffu waqa’ apposta u t-tfal infaqgħu jidħku.
words.exampleEnglish: The clown fell on purpose and the children burst out laughing.

words.meaning: Persuna jew kreatura għolja u kbira ħafna, spiss fil-ħrejjef.
words.example: Fil-ħrafa, il-ġigant kien jgħix fuq is-sħab.
words.exampleEnglish: In the fairy tale, the giant lived above the clouds.

words.meaning: Persuna li tagħmel xi ħaġa kuraġġuża biex issalva lil ħaddieħor.
words.example: Il-pompier sar eroj meta salva lit-tarbija.
words.exampleEnglish: The firefighter became a hero when he saved the baby.

words.meaning: Bin sultan jew reġina, jew membru tal-familja rjali.
words.example: Il-prinċep rikeb iż-żiemel abjad lejn il-kastell.
words.exampleEnglish: The prince rode the white horse to the castle.

words.meaning: Bint sultan jew reġina, jew il-mara ta’ prinċep.
words.exampleEnglish: The princess wore a small silver crown.

words.meaning: Gwerrier ta’ żmien ilu, ġeneralment armat u fuq iż-żiemel.
words.example: Il-kavallieri ta’ San Ġwann bnew il-Belt Valletta.
words.exampleEnglish: The Knights of St John built Valletta.

words.meaning: Kap tal-knisja f’żona partikolari, ogħla mill-qassisin.
words.exampleEnglish: The bishop blessed the new church.

words.meaning: Mara li tiddedika ħajjitha lil Alla u tgħix f’komunità reliġjuża.
words.exampleEnglish: The nun used to teach at the girls' school.

words.meaning: Raġel reliġjuż li jgħix f’kunvent, bħal Franġiskan jew Dumnikan.
words.exampleEnglish: The friar distributed bread to the poor.

words.meaning: Persuna li tieħu ħsieb il-knisja, il-qniepen u l-oġġetti tal-quddies.
words.exampleEnglish: The sacristan rang the seven o'clock bell.

words.meaning: Il-parti tal-wiċċ taħt l-għajn, fuq kull naħa tal-imnieħer.
words.exampleEnglish: Grandmother kissed the boy on his cheek.

words.meaning: Waħda mill-ħames partijiet twal fit-tarf tal-id jew tas-sieq.
words.example: Qabad saba bil-bieb u beda jibki.
words.exampleEnglish: He caught a finger in the door and started crying.

words.meaning: Iż-żewġ organi tal-wiċċ li bihom naraw.
words.exampleEnglish: Our cat has green eyes.

words.meaning: Iż-żewġ organi fuq in-naħat tar-ras li bihom nisimgħu.
words.exampleEnglish: The rabbit has very long ears.

words.meaning: Iż-żewġ partijiet fit-tarf tad-dirgħajn li bihom naqbdu l-affarijiet.
words.example: Wara l-borra, l-idejn tiegħu kienu kesħin silġ.
words.exampleEnglish: After the snow, his hands were ice cold.

words.meaning: Iż-żewġ partijiet t’isfel tar-riġlejn li bihom nimxu.
words.example: Wara l-mixja twila, is-saqajn kienu għajjenin.
words.exampleEnglish: After the long walk, the feet were tired.

words.meaning: Iż-żewġ partijiet twal tal-ġisem mill-ġenbejn sas-saqajn.
words.exampleEnglish: After the marathon the legs were tired.

words.meaning: Iż-żewġ partijiet tal-ġisem mill-ispallejn sal-idejn.
words.exampleEnglish: The octopus has eight arms.

words.meaning: Iż-żewġ naħat ta’ fuq tal-ġisem fejn jibdew id-dirgħajn.
words.exampleEnglish: The jacket was tight across the shoulders.

words.meaning: Il-post fejn żewġ għadmiet jiltaqgħu u jħallu l-ġisem jitgħawweġ.
words.exampleEnglish: The cold makes every joint hurt.

words.meaning: L-arja li tidħol u toħroġ mill-pulmun meta tieħu n-nifs.
words.exampleEnglish: He took a deep breath before diving.

words.meaning: Ħoss qawwi u f’daqqa li joħroġ mill-gerżuma meta tkun marid.
words.example: Is-sogħla ma ħallietux jorqod il-lejl kollu.
words.exampleEnglish: The cough kept him awake all night.

words.meaning: Ħruġ f’daqqa u bil-qawwa tal-arja mill-imnieħer u l-ħalq.
words.exampleEnglish: He gave a big sneeze because of the dust.

words.meaning: Meta l-ġisem ikun sħun aktar min-normal għax tkun marid.
words.example: It-tifel kellu d-deni u baqa’ d-dar.
words.exampleEnglish: The boy had a fever and stayed home.

words.meaning: Sensazzjoni ħażina fil-ġisem meta tkun weġġajt jew marid.
words.exampleEnglish: He felt a sharp pain in his back.

words.meaning: Meta għadma tinkiser.
words.exampleEnglish: The X-ray showed a fracture in the arm.

words.meaning: Strixxa drapp li tintlibes madwar ġerħa jew ġog imweġġa’.
words.exampleEnglish: The nurse put a bandage on the knee.

words.meaning: Biċċa mediċina żgħira u iebsa li tibilagħha bl-ilma.
words.exampleEnglish: He took a pill for the headache.

words.meaning: Mediċina li tiddaħħal fil-ġisem permezz ta’ labra.
words.exampleEnglish: The doctor gave him a flu injection.

words.meaning: Strument li jkejjel it-temperatura tal-ġisem jew tal-arja.
words.example: It-termometru wera tmienja u tletin grad.
words.exampleEnglish: The thermometer showed thirty-eight degrees.

words.meaning: Persuna li qed tirċievi kura mingħand tabib jew f’isptar.
words.exampleEnglish: The patient waited an hour at the clinic.

words.meaning: Li m’huwiex f’saħħtu għax għandu xi marda.
words.example: Ħija marid, għalhekk ma marx l-iskola.
words.exampleEnglish: My brother is ill, so he didn't go to school.

words.meaning: Problema fil-ġisem jew fil-moħħ li tagħmel lil persuna ma tiflaħx.
words.exampleEnglish: The illness passed after a week of rest.

words.meaning: Meta l-ġisem u l-moħħ ikunu tajbin u jaħdmu sew.
words.exampleEnglish: Fruit and vegetables help health.

words.meaning: Tabib li jieħu ħsieb is-snien u l-ħalq.
words.exampleEnglish: The dentist cleaned my teeth.

words.meaning: Persuna mħarrġa li tħejji u tbigħ il-mediċini.
words.exampleEnglish: The pharmacist explained how to take the medicine.

words.meaning: Vettura li ġġorr persuni morda jew midruba lejn l-isptar.
words.exampleEnglish: The ambulance arrived in ten minutes.

words.meaning: L-istat ta’ mistrieħ meta l-ġisem jorqod.
words.example: Tmien sigħat rqad huma importanti għat-tfal.
words.exampleEnglish: Eight hours of sleep are important for children.

words.meaning: Is-sensazzjoni li m’għandekx saħħa u trid tistrieħ.
words.exampleEnglish: Out of tiredness he fell asleep on the sofa.

words.meaning: Likwidu mielaħ li joħroġ mill-ġilda meta jkollok sħana.
words.exampleEnglish: After the match he was soaked in sweat.

words.meaning: Kemm hi tqila persuna jew ħaġa.
words.exampleEnglish: The farmer measured the weight of the potatoes.

words.meaning: Attività fiżika li tagħmel biex iżżomm il-ġisem f’saħħtu.
words.exampleEnglish: Every day he does half an hour of exercise.

words.meaning: Li ma jistax jara.
words.exampleEnglish: The dog guides the blind man in the street.

words.meaning: Li ma jistax jisma’ jew jisma’ ftit ħafna.
words.example: In-nannu sar ftit trux, għalhekk nitkellmu b’leħen għoli.
words.exampleEnglish: Grandfather became a little deaf, so we speak loudly.

words.meaning: Li jimxi b’mod mhux indaqs għax għandu riġel imweġġa’.
words.exampleEnglish: The dog remained lame after the accident.

words.meaning: Li m’għandux saħħa u jrid jistrieħ jew jorqod.
words.exampleEnglish: He arrived home dead tired.

words.meaning: Li qed jorqod.
words.exampleEnglish: The boy was asleep on the bed.

words.meaning: Kamra fid-dar fejn tilqa’ l-mistednin u tistrieħ.
words.exampleEnglish: The family sat in the living room watching the news.

words.meaning: Reċipjent kbir mimli ilma fejn tinħasel, jew il-kamra fejn jinsab.
words.example: It-tarbija ħadet banju sħun qabel torqod.
words.exampleEnglish: The baby had a warm bath before sleeping.

words.meaning: Apparat li jitfa’ l-ilma minn fuq biex tinħasel bil-wieqfa.
words.example: Wara l-baħar ħadt doċċa biex inneħħi l-melħ.
