words.exampleEnglish: After the sea I took a shower to remove the salt.

words.meaning: Baċin imwaħħal mal-ħajt b’vit tal-ilma, fil-kċina jew fil-kamra tal-banju.
words.exampleEnglish: I left the dirty plates in the sink.

words.meaning: Struttura ħierġa mill-faċċata tad-dar, spiss tal-injam u kkulurita.
words.example: In-nanna kienet tħares lejn it-triq mill-gallarija.
words.exampleEnglish: Grandmother used to look out at the street from the balcony.

words.meaning: Kamra taħt id-dar fejn jinżammu affarijiet, xorb jew ikel.
words.exampleEnglish: The wine bottles are kept in the cellar.

words.meaning: Passaġġ dejjaq ġewwa bini li jwassal minn kamra għal oħra.
words.exampleEnglish: The children ran in the school corridor.

words.meaning: Il-post fejn tidħol f’bini, jew l-ewwel parti tad-dar.
words.exampleEnglish: We left our shoes in the entrance.

words.meaning: Pass wieħed ta’ taraġ.
words.example: Oqgħod attent għax it-tarġa ta’ isfel hija miksura.
words.exampleEnglish: Be careful because the bottom step is broken.

words.meaning: Borża ratba mimlija, użata biex toqgħod jew tistrieħ aktar komdu.
words.example: Poġġa kuxxin wara dahru fuq is-siġġu.
words.exampleEnglish: He put a cushion behind his back on the chair.

words.meaning: Il-parti ħoxna u ratba tas-sodda li fuqha timtedd.
words.example: Xtraw materass ġdid għax il-qadim kien iebes.
words.exampleEnglish: They bought a new mattress because the old one was hard.

words.meaning: Biċċa għamara żgħira b’kexxun li titqiegħed ħdejn is-sodda.
words.exampleEnglish: He put the alarm clock on the bedside table.

words.meaning: Sodda żgħira, xi kultant tixxengel, fejn torqod it-tarbija.
words.example: L-omm xenglet il-benniena sakemm it-tarbija raqdet.
words.exampleEnglish: The mother rocked the cradle until the baby fell asleep.

words.meaning: Reċipjent tal-fuħħar jew plastik fejn titħawwel pjanta.
words.example: Il-ħabaq qed jikber fil-qasrija fuq it-tieqa.
words.exampleEnglish: The basil is growing in the flowerpot on the window.

words.meaning: Reċipjent sabiħ li fih jitqiegħdu l-fjuri maqtugħa.
words.exampleEnglish: She put the roses in the crystal vase.

words.meaning: Il-parti tal-ħġieġ li tagħti d-dawl meta tixgħel il-lampa.
words.exampleEnglish: The kitchen light bulb blew.

words.meaning: Buttuna mal-ħajt li biha tixgħel u titfi d-dawl.
words.exampleEnglish: I couldn't find the switch in the dark.

words.meaning: Apparat bi skrin li juri programmi, filmati u aħbarijiet.
words.exampleEnglish: The children watched cartoons on television.

words.meaning: Apparat li jirċievi u jdoqq programmi u mużika mill-arja.
words.exampleEnglish: In the car we listened to the match on the radio.

words.meaning: Bieb tal-injam bl-irqajja’ fuq barra tat-tieqa li jilqa’ x-xemx.
words.exampleEnglish: One shutter was broken by the wind.

words.meaning: Tapit irqiq minsuġ minn materjal naturali bħall-qasab.
words.example: Qegħdu ħasira mal-art biex ipoġġu fuqha.
words.exampleEnglish: They laid a mat on the floor to sit on.

words.meaning: Oġġett tal-metall imwaħħal mal-bieb li bih tħabbat biex jiftħulek.
words.example: Il-ħabbata tal-ottun kellha forma ta’ denfil.
words.exampleEnglish: The brass door knocker was shaped like a dolphin.

words.meaning: Il-parti tal-ġebel jew tal-injam f’qiegħ il-bieb, li taqsamha biex tidħol.
words.exampleEnglish: The cat sat on the doorstep waiting.

words.meaning: Ħajt jew xatba madwar art jew bini biex jagħlaqha.
words.exampleEnglish: The dog jumped over the garden fence.

words.meaning: Kamra jew bini fejn tinżamm il-karozza.
words.exampleEnglish: He put the car in the garage because of the hail.

words.meaning: Spazju miftuħ ħiereġ mill-faċċata jew fuq is-saqaf, b’parapett.
words.exampleEnglish: We sat eating on the terrace in summer.

words.meaning: Ħajt baxx fit-tarf ta’ bejt jew gallarija biex ma taqax.
words.exampleEnglish: The boy looked over the parapet of the roof.

words.meaning: Wajer jew virga li taqbad is-sinjal tar-radju jew tat-televiżjoni.
words.exampleEnglish: The strong wind knocked the antenna off the roof.

words.meaning: Biċċa ratba li tixrob l-ilma, użata għall-ħasil u t-tindif.
words.exampleEnglish: He cleaned the plates with the sponge and soap.

words.meaning: Platt fond u tond fejn jitqiegħed ikel bħal soppa jew ċereali.
words.exampleEnglish: I had a bowl of cereal with milk.

words.meaning: Mgħarfa kbira u fonda b’manku twil li biha sservi s-soppa.
words.exampleEnglish: He served the soup with the ladle.

words.meaning: Reċipjent kbir tal-fuħħar b’għonq dejjaq għall-ilma jew iż-żejt.
words.exampleEnglish: They used to keep olive oil in the jar.

words.meaning: Reċipjent żgħir tal-ħġieġ b’għatu, użat għall-ikel.
words.example: Il-vażett tal-għasel kien diffiċli biex jinfetaħ.
words.exampleEnglish: The honey jar was hard to open.

words.meaning: Għatu żgħir tal-kurk, plastik jew metall li jagħlaq flixkun.
words.exampleEnglish: He couldn't find the cap of the water bottle.

words.meaning: Biċċa drapp li tintrabat quddiem biex tipproteġi l-ħwejjeġ.
words.exampleEnglish: She put on the apron before she started kneading.

words.meaning: Biċċa karta jew drapp li biha timsaħ ħalqek u idejk waqt l-ikel.
words.exampleEnglish: He put a napkin next to every plate.

words.meaning: Biċċa drapp kbira li titqiegħed fuq il-mejda għall-ikel.
words.exampleEnglish: For the feast they spread a white tablecloth.

words.meaning: Żrieragħ ibsin u ħelwin ġewwa qoxra, użati fil-ħelu.
words.exampleEnglish: Grandmother made the almond biscuits.

words.meaning: Żrieragħ żgħar li jikbru taħt l-art, jittieklu mixwija.
words.exampleEnglish: At the feast we bought a bag of hot peanuts.

words.meaning: Frott kannella u lixx li jinxtewa jew jissajjar fix-xitwa.
words.example: Ix-xiħ kien ibigħ il-qastan mixwi fit-triq.
words.exampleEnglish: The old man sold roasted chestnuts in the street.

words.meaning: Ħaxix aħdar, twil jew tond, li jinqela jew jimtela.
words.exampleEnglish: She made stuffed marrows with meat.

words.meaning: Ħaxixa twila u vjola li tissajjar fil-forn jew tinqela.
words.exampleEnglish: Stuffed aubergine is a traditional meal.

words.meaning: Ħaxixa b’weraq kbar u ħodor li jittieklu nejjin fl-insalata.
words.exampleEnglish: He rinsed the lettuce well before the salad.

words.meaning: Ħaxixa b’zkuk twal u ħodor u riħa qawwija.
words.example: Il-minestra ma tkunx tajba mingħajr karfus.
words.exampleEnglish: Minestrone is not good without celery.

words.meaning: Għerq tond u aħmar skur li jissajjar jew jittiekel fl-insalata.
words.exampleEnglish: The beetroot stained the whole plate red.

words.meaning: Frott żgħir, tond u aħmar b’għadma waħda ġewwa.
words.exampleEnglish: Cherries arrive at the market in June.

words.meaning: Frotta ratba u tonda, vjola jew safra, b’għadma waħda.
words.exampleEnglish: He ate a ripe plum from the tree.

words.meaning: Soppa tradizzjonali Maltija bil-kaboċċi, il-qargħa u l-majjal.
words.exampleEnglish: In winter Grandmother used to make kawlata.

words.meaning: Soppa ħoxna b’ħafna ħxejjex u kultant għaġin.
words.exampleEnglish: The hot minestrone warmed us in the cold.

words.meaning: Għaġin forma ta’ tubi qosra, jew l-ikla magħmula bih fil-forn.
words.example: L-imqarrun il-forn huwa l-ikla favorita tiegħi.
words.exampleEnglish: Baked macaroni is my favourite meal.

words.meaning: Mqarrun moħmi ġewwa għaġina tal-pejst, ikla tradizzjonali Maltija.
words.exampleEnglish: For Sunday Grandmother baked a big timpana.

words.meaning: Biċċiet irqaq tal-laħam imlibbsa b’mili u msajra fiz-zalza.
words.exampleEnglish: The beef olives cooked in tomato sauce.

words.meaning: Ikla tal-laħam u ħxejjex imsajra bil-mod f’borma.
words.exampleEnglish: For lunch we had rabbit stew.

words.meaning: Taħlita ħoxna tal-ful mitħun bit-tewm u ż-żejt, tittiekel mal-galletti.
words.exampleEnglish: They served the bigilla with crackers and cheeselets.

words.meaning: Ġobon żgħir u tond tal-ħalib tan-nagħaġ, frisk jew niexef.
words.exampleEnglish: He ate a peppered cheeselet with bread.

words.meaning: Ħelu jew ħobż forma ta’ ċirku; il-qagħqa tal-għasel hi magħrufa.
words.exampleEnglish: I bought a treacle ring for Christmas.

words.meaning: Ħelu Malti forma ta’ djamanti, mimli bit-tamal u moqli.
words.exampleEnglish: In Valletta we bought hot imqaret from the kiosk.

words.meaning: Ħelu tal-Għid magħmul mill-għaġina u l-lewż, forma ta’ figura.
words.example: It-tfal irċevew figolla forma ta’ ħaruf.
words.exampleEnglish: The children received a lamb-shaped figolla.

words.meaning: Ħelu tal-Karnival bil-krema, il-prinjoli u ċ-ċikkulata.
words.exampleEnglish: At Carnival we always buy a piece of prinjolata.

words.meaning: Biskuttin tal-lewż, għasel u ħwawar, magħmul fir-Randan.
words.exampleEnglish: Lent doesn't pass without kwareżimal.

words.meaning: Għaġina tonda mimlija bl-irkotta, il-piżelli jew l-ispinaċi.
words.exampleEnglish: For breakfast he ate a ricotta qassata.

words.meaning: Ħut tal-baħar mitlub ħafna fil-ħarifa, spiss isir torta.
words.exampleEnglish: Grandmother made a lampuki pie.

words.meaning: Ħuta kbira u kannella li tgħix bejn il-blat fil-fond.
words.example: Is-sajjied qabad ċerna ta’ għaxar kilos.
words.exampleEnglish: The fisherman caught a ten-kilo grouper.

words.meaning: Ħuta kbira u mgħaġġla tal-baħar, magħrufa wkoll fil-landa.
words.exampleEnglish: Bread with oil, tuna and tomatoes.

words.meaning: Ħuta ta’ kulur fidda b’tikka safra, spiss imrobbija fl-irziezet tal-ħut.
words.exampleEnglish: We grilled a sea bream.

words.meaning: Ħuta kbira tal-baħar b’imnieħer twil u ċatt bħal xabla.
words.exampleEnglish: I ordered a swordfish steak at the restaurant.

words.meaning: Ħut żgħir u fidda li jgħum f’ħafna flimkien u jinbiegħ friski jew fil-landa.
words.exampleEnglish: He opened a can of sardines for lunch.

words.meaning: Soppa Maltija tal-ħut bit-tewm, it-tadam u l-ħxejjex.
words.example: Wara s-sajd għamlu aljotta bil-ħut li qabdu.
words.exampleEnglish: After fishing they made fish soup with their catch.

words.meaning: Laħam tal-majjal immellaħ u mnixxef, maqtugħ fi flieli rqaq.
words.exampleEnglish: He made a ham and cheese sandwich.

words.meaning: Il-likwidu li toħroġ mill-frott meta tagħfsu.
words.exampleEnglish: Every morning I drink orange juice.

words.meaning: Xarba friska magħmula mill-meraq tal-lumi, ilma u zokkor.
words.exampleEnglish: In the heat we drank cold lemonade.

words.meaning: Xarba alkoħolika magħmula mill-għeneb magħsur.
words.exampleEnglish: The farmer made wine from his own grapes.

words.meaning: Il-parti xaħmija tal-ħalib, użata fil-ħelu u fit-tisjir.
words.exampleEnglish: She added cream to the strawberries.

words.meaning: Ikel artab magħmul mill-ħalib li jitqares b’batterji tajbin.
words.exampleEnglish: He ate yoghurt with honey for breakfast.

words.meaning: Ġobon abjad u artab użat fil-pastizzi u fil-qassatat.
words.exampleEnglish: Ricotta pastizzi are sold hot.

words.meaning: Għaġina ċatta moħmija bit-tadam, il-ġobon u ingredjenti oħra.
words.exampleEnglish: On Friday evening we order pizza.

words.meaning: Ikel moħmi b’qoxra tal-għaġina u mili ħelu jew mielaħ.
words.exampleEnglish: She made a ricotta pie for the feast.

words.meaning: Sustanzi niexfa ta’ pjanti, bħall-bżar u l-kannella, li jagħtu togħma.
words.exampleEnglish: The sauce had too many spices for the children.

words.meaning: Pjanta b’weraq ħodor u fwieħa, użata fit-tisjir.
words.exampleEnglish: She picked some basil for the tomato sauce.

words.meaning: Pjanta b’weraq ħodor u rqaq użati biex jagħtu togħma.
words.exampleEnglish: She sprinkled the parsley on the potatoes.

words.meaning: Ħaxixa kbira u tonda b’weraq ħodor magħluqa fuq xulxin.
words.exampleEnglish: Kawlata is made with cabbage.

words.meaning: Ħaxixa b’weraq ħodor u rotob, imsajra jew nejja.
words.exampleEnglish: The spinach qassata was still warm.

words.meaning: Organiżmu b’zokk u kappell li xi wħud minnu jittieklu.
words.exampleEnglish: She added mushrooms to the pasta.

words.meaning: Annimal Awstraljan li jaqbeż fuq saqajh ta’ wara u jġorr il-wild f’borża.
words.example: Il-kanguru qabeż minn naħa tal-għalqa għall-oħra.
words.exampleEnglish: The kangaroo jumped from one side of the field to the other.

words.meaning: Għasfur iswed u abjad tal-kesħa li jgħum tajjeb imma ma jtirx.
words.example: Il-pingwin żelaq fuq is-silġ u daħal fl-ilma.
words.exampleEnglish: The penguin slid on the ice and went into the water.

words.meaning: Ors iswed u abjad miċ-Ċina li jiekol il-bambù.
words.exampleEnglish: The panda sat chewing bamboo.

words.meaning: Annimal Awstraljan żgħir u griż li jgħix fis-siġar.
words.exampleEnglish: The koala slept clinging to the branch.

words.meaning: Annimal Afrikan kbir u tqil li jqatta’ ħafna ħin fl-ilma.
words.example: L-ippopotamu fetaħ ħalqu kbir ħdejn ix-xmara.
words.exampleEnglish: The hippopotamus opened its huge mouth by the river.

words.meaning: Annimal kbir b’ġilda ħoxna u qarn wieħed jew tnejn fuq l-imnieħer.
words.example: Fiż-żoo rajna rinoċerontu kbir jiekol il-ħaxix.
words.exampleEnglish: At the zoo we saw a big rhinoceros eating grass.

words.meaning: Qattus selvaġġ kbir, isfar bit-tikki suwed, li jitla’ mas-siġar.
words.exampleEnglish: The leopard carried its prey up the tree.

words.meaning: Annimal tal-foresta li r-raġel tiegħu għandu qrun bil-friegħi.
words.example: Iċ-ċerv waqaf jisma’ qabel ma ġera.
words.exampleEnglish: The deer stopped to listen before it ran.

words.meaning: Annimal ħafif u mgħaġġel tas-savana b’qrun irqaq.
words.exampleEnglish: The gazelle escaped from the lion.

words.meaning: Annimal żgħir b’denb folt li jgħix fis-siġar u jiġbor il-ġewż.
words.exampleEnglish: A squirrel hid a nut in the soil.

words.meaning: Il-wild ta’ kelb meta jkun għadu żgħir.
words.exampleEnglish: The puppy started chasing its tail.

words.meaning: Il-femminil tal-qattus.
words.exampleEnglish: The female cat gave birth to four kittens.

words.meaning: Il-femminil tal-kelb.
words.exampleEnglish: The female dog guarded her puppies.

words.meaning: Annimal tar-razzett imrobbi għal-laħam; isem ieħor għall-ħanżir.
words.exampleEnglish: The pig was rolling in the mud.

words.meaning: Annimal li jitwieled minn żiemel u ħmara, b’saħħtu ħafna għax-xogħol.
words.exampleEnglish: The mule carried the load to the top.

words.meaning: Għasfur blu skur li jgħix fl-irdumijiet; l-għasfur nazzjonali ta’ Malta.
words.example: Il-merill kien qed ikanta fuq l-irdum.
words.exampleEnglish: The blue rock thrush was singing on the cliff.

words.meaning: Għasfur żgħir b’denb maqsum li jasal fir-rebbiegħa.
words.exampleEnglish: The swallow built its nest under the balcony.

words.meaning: Għasfur żgħir ikkulurit, b’wiċċ aħmar u ġwienaħ sofor.
words.example: Il-gardell kanta minn fuq is-siġra tal-lewż.
words.exampleEnglish: The goldfinch sang from the almond tree.

words.meaning: Għasfur żgħir u isfar, magħruf għall-kant ħelu tiegħu.
words.exampleEnglish: Grandfather's canary sang all morning.

words.meaning: Għasfur żgħir u kannella tal-għelieqi li jtir baxx.
words.exampleEnglish: A quail rose from the wheat and flew off.

words.meaning: Għasfur kbir ħafna li ma jtirx imma jiġri malajr.
words.exampleEnglish: The ostrich ran faster than the car.

words.meaning: Għasfur b’rix sabiħ blu u aħdar li jiftaħ denbu bħal mrewħa.
words.exampleEnglish: The peacock spread its tail in front of the guests.

words.meaning: Kaxxa bil-vireg tal-metall fejn jinżammu għasafar jew annimali.
words.exampleEnglish: Grandmother cleaned the canary's cage.

words.meaning: Grupp ta’ annimali, l-aktar nagħaġ jew mogħoż, li jimxu flimkien.
words.exampleEnglish: The shepherd gathered the flock before dark.

words.meaning: Il-wild ta’ qattus meta jkun għadu żgħir.
words.exampleEnglish: The kittens played with the ball of wool.

words.meaning: Ħafna mid-dubbien, l-insetti li jtiru madwar l-ikel.
words.exampleEnglish: The flies were buzzing round the fruit.

words.meaning: Ħafna mill-insetti żgħar li jgħixu f’kolonji.
words.exampleEnglish: The ants carried the crumbs to the nest.

words.meaning: Annimal tal-baħar b’ġisem twil u artab u għaxar dirgħajn.
words.exampleEnglish: Fried squid is popular in summer.

words.meaning: Annimal żgħir u tond tal-baħar miksi bix-xewk.
words.example: Iġbed sieqek, hemm rizzu fuq il-blata!
words.exampleEnglish: Pull your foot back, there's a sea urchin on the rock!

words.meaning: Ħuta griża u fidda li tinxtewa jew tinqela.
words.exampleEnglish: For lunch we cooked a sea bass in the oven.

words.meaning: Ħuta żgħira blu u fidda bi strixxi skuri fuq dahra.
words.exampleEnglish: The fisherman filled the box with mackerel.

words.meaning: Ħuta żgħira u fidda li tgħix qrib il-kosta f’għadd kbir.
words.exampleEnglish: The bogues took the bait at once.

words.meaning: Ħuta tal-baħar b’laħam abjad u ratba.
words.exampleEnglish: The hake didn't have many bones.

words.meaning: Ħuta kbira b’laħam roża li titla’ max-xmajjar.
words.exampleEnglish: She ordered salmon with potatoes.

words.meaning: Ħuta mnixxfa u mmellħa li trid titgħaddas fl-ilma qabel tissajjar.
words.exampleEnglish: The salt cod soaked a whole night in water.

words.meaning: Mammiferu tal-baħar b’ġisem lixx u pinen, li joħroġ fuq il-blat.
words.example: Il-foka ħarġet fuq il-blat tieħu x-xemx.
words.exampleEnglish: The seal climbed onto the rocks to sunbathe.

words.meaning: Għadam irqiq tal-ħut, jew il-ponot tal-pjanti.
words.example: Oqgħod attent għax il-ħuta fiha ħafna xewk.
words.exampleEnglish: Be careful because the fish has many bones.

words.meaning: Dgħajsa tradizzjonali Maltija tas-sajd, ikkulurita u b’għajn fuq quddiem.
words.example: Il-luzzu ikkulurit daħal fil-port ta’ Marsaxlokk.
words.exampleEnglish: The colourful luzzu entered Marsaxlokk harbour.

words.meaning: Dgħajsa tradizzjonali Maltija tas-sajd, iżgħar mil-luzzu.
words.example: In-nannu kien joħroġ bil-kajjik kull filgħodu.
words.exampleEnglish: Grandfather used to go out in the kajjik every morning.

words.meaning: Metodu tradizzjonali ta’ sajd tal-lampuki bil-weraq tal-palm f’wiċċ il-baħar.
words.exampleEnglish: In autumn fishermen lay out the kannizzati.

words.meaning: Linja twila tas-sajd b’ħafna snanar imqabbdin magħha.
words.exampleEnglish: The fisherman hauled in the longline with many swordfish.

words.meaning: Virga twila u flessibbli tas-sajd; jew zokk tal-qasab.
words.exampleEnglish: He sat on the quay with the fishing rod until noon.

words.meaning: Mogħdija tal-ġebel jew tal-konkos tul il-port fejn jorbtu d-dgħajjes.
words.exampleEnglish: The fishermen unloaded the fish on the quay.

words.meaning: L-attività jew ix-xogħol li taqbad il-ħut.
words.exampleEnglish: Fishing is an ancient craft in Malta.

words.meaning: L-ammont ta’ ħut li jinqabad f’ħarġa tas-sajd.
words.exampleEnglish: Today's catch was big.

words.meaning: Port żgħir u protett fejn jinżammu d-dgħajjes tas-sajd.
words.exampleEnglish: The boats were moored in the small harbour.

words.meaning: Strument b’labra li dejjem turi lejn it-tramuntana.
words.exampleEnglish: With the compass he found his way back.

words.meaning: Torri b’dawl qawwi fuq il-kosta biex jgwida l-vapuri billejl.
words.example: Il-fanal ta’ Ġordan jidher minn ħafna Għawdex.
words.exampleEnglish: Giordan lighthouse can be seen from much of Gozo.

words.meaning: Port fejn jinżammu jottijiet u dgħajjes tal-pjaċir.
words.exampleEnglish: The marina was full of yachts.

words.meaning: Dgħajsa kbira u lussuża bil-qlugħ jew bil-magna.
words.exampleEnglish: A white yacht entered the bay.

words.meaning: Ħafna mewġiet fil-baħar.
words.example: Il-mewġ kien għoli wisq biex ngħumu.
words.exampleEnglish: The waves were too high to swim.

words.meaning: Riħ qawwi u frisk li jonfoħ mill-majjistral.
words.exampleEnglish: The mistral made the Gozo sea rough.

words.meaning: Riħ kiesaħ u qawwi li jonfoħ mill-grigal, speċjalment fix-xitwa.
words.exampleEnglish: The gregale forced the ship to stay in port.

words.meaning: Riħ sħun u niedi li jonfoħ mix-xlokk, mill-Afrika.
words.exampleEnglish: With the sirocco the clothes don't dry.

words.meaning: Riħ li jonfoħ mil-lbiċ, bejn in-nofsinhar u l-punent.
words.example: Il-lbiċ ġab il-ħaxix tal-baħar fuq ix-xatt.
words.exampleEnglish: The south-west wind brought seaweed onto the shore.

words.meaning: Iż-żewġ dwiefer kbar tal-granċ jew tal-istakkoża.
words.exampleEnglish: The crab caught me with one of its pincers.

words.meaning: Il-parti tal-art li tmiss mal-baħar, mal-kosti ta’ pajjiż.
words.example: Imxejna tul il-kosta minn Marsaskala sa San Tumas.
words.exampleEnglish: We walked along the coast from Marsaskala to St Thomas.

words.meaning: Medda ta’ art imdawra bl-ilma minn tliet naħat.
words.example: Il-Belt Valletta hija mibnija fuq peniżola.
words.exampleEnglish: Valletta is built on a peninsula.

words.meaning: Medda kbira ħafna ta’ art, bħall-Afrika jew l-Asja.
words.example: L-Afrika hija l-kontinent l-eqreb lejn Malta.
words.exampleEnglish: Africa is the continent nearest to Malta.

words.meaning: Medda kbira ta’ art niexfa fejn ma tagħmilx xita.
words.exampleEnglish: The camel lives well in the desert.

words.meaning: Foresta ħoxna u niedja f’pajjiżi sħan.
words.example: Fil-ġungla hemm ħafna xadini u papagalli.
words.exampleEnglish: In the jungle there are many monkeys and parrots.

words.meaning: Muntanja li minnha jista’ joħroġ blat imdewweb, duħħan u rmied.
words.example: L-Etna hija vulkan attiv fi Sqallija.
words.exampleEnglish: Etna is an active volcano in Sicily.

words.meaning: Medda kbira ta’ ilma ħelu mdawra bl-art.
words.exampleEnglish: We took a boat on the lake in Italy.

words.meaning: Grupp ta’ gżejjer qrib xulxin.
words.example: Malta, Għawdex u Kemmuna jiffurmaw arċipelagu.
words.exampleEnglish: Malta, Gozo and Comino form an archipelago.

words.meaning: Il-materjal iebes li jifforma l-art u l-irdumijiet.

words.meaning: L-art barra mill-bliet u l-irħula, b’għelieqi u natura.
words.exampleEnglish: On Sunday we went for a walk in the countryside.

words.meaning: Art blatija b’ħaxix baxx u pjanti selvaġġi, komuni f’Malta.

words.meaning: Ġebla iebsa u lixxa, spiss bajda, użata għall-istatwi u l-art.

words.meaning: Materjal iswed u iebes li jinħaraq biex jagħti s-sħana.

words.meaning: Ħġieġ ta’ kwalità għolja jew minerali trasparenti b’forom regolari.
words.exampleEnglish: The crystal chandelier was sparkling.

words.meaning: Ġisem kbir fl-ispazju li jdur max-xemx jew ma’ stilla.
words.example: Marte huwa magħruf bħala l-pjaneta l-ħamra.
words.exampleEnglish: Mars is known as the red planet.

words.meaning: Il-firxa kbira fejn jinsabu l-pjaneti u l-istilel.

words.meaning: Grupp kbir ħafna ta’ stilel, pjaneti u trab fl-ispazju.

words.meaning: Ġisem tas-silġ u t-trab fl-ispazju li jħalli denb ta’ dawl.
words.example: Il-kometa dehret fis-sema għal ftit ġranet.

words.meaning: Persuna mħarrġa biex tivvjaġġa u taħdem fl-ispazju.

words.meaning: Meta pjaneta jew qamar jgħatti d-dawl ta’ ġisem ieħor.

words.exampleEnglish: The cellar wall is damp.

words.meaning: Meta x-xemx tkun barra u ma jkunx hemm sħab.
words.exampleEnglish: Today the weather is sunny and warm.

words.meaning: Temperatura baxxa li ġġiegħlek tħossok kiesaħ.
words.exampleEnglish: In the cold, lips crack.

words.meaning: Li għandu temperatura għolja.
words.exampleEnglish: The sun is hot at noon.

words.meaning: Li għandu temperatura baxxa.
words.exampleEnglish: The sea water was cold in May.

words.meaning: Maltempata qawwija ħafna b’riħ li jdur u jagħmel ħsara.
words.exampleEnglish: The hurricane destroyed many houses in the Caribbean.

words.meaning: It-temp normali ta’ post matul is-snin.
words.example: Malta għandha klima sħuna u niexfa fis-sajf.
words.exampleEnglish: Malta has a hot, dry climate in summer.

words.meaning: Perjodu twil mingħajr xita li jnixxef l-art.

words.meaning: Ilma li sar gass minħabba s-sħana.
words.exampleEnglish: Steam rose from the kettle.

words.meaning: Biċċa żgħira ħafna ta’ likwidu.
words.exampleEnglish: A raindrop fell on my nose.

words.meaning: Iż-żmien meta x-xemx tkun għadha kif inżlet u jibda jidlam.
words.exampleEnglish: At dusk the bats come out to fly.

words.meaning: Fjura fwejħa, spiss ħamra, li tikber fuq pjanta bix-xewk.
words.exampleEnglish: He gave her a red rose on Valentine's Day.

words.meaning: Pjanta tielgħa b’fjuri bojod żgħar u fwieħa ħafna.

words.meaning: Pjanta b’fjuri sofor li tkopri l-għelieqi Maltin fix-xitwa.

words.meaning: Pjanta b’fjuri ħomor li tikber fl-għelieqi u tintuża bħala għalf.
words.exampleEnglish: The farmer cut the sulla for the livestock.

words.meaning: Pjanti twal b’zokk vojt li jikbru ħdejn l-ilma.

words.meaning: Pjanta tax-xewk b’weraq ċatti u ħoxnin li tagħti l-bajtar.

words.meaning: Siġra b’imżiewed kannella u ħelwin; jew l-imżiewed infushom.
words.exampleEnglish: Carob syrup is good for a cough.

words.meaning: Grupp ta’ ħabbiet tal-għeneb imqabbdin ma’ zokk wieħed.
words.exampleEnglish: He cut a bunch of grapes from the vine.

words.meaning: Pjanta tielgħa li tagħti l-għeneb.

words.meaning: Il-ġbir tal-qamħ u ta’ wiċċ ieħor meta jkun misjur.
words.exampleEnglish: The harvest is done at the beginning of summer.

words.meaning: Ix-xogħol li tqiegħed iż-żerriegħa fil-ħamrija biex tikber.
words.exampleEnglish: Autumn is sowing time.

words.meaning: Għodda kbira li taqleb u tħaffer il-ħamrija qabel iż-żrigħ.
words.exampleEnglish: The mule used to pull the plough.

words.meaning: Ħajt tradizzjonali tal-ġebel mibni mingħajr tajn jew siment.
words.exampleEnglish: The farmer repaired the field's rubble wall.

words.meaning: Ħmieġ tal-annimali użat biex jagħmel l-art aktar fertili.
words.exampleEnglish: The farmer spread manure on the field.

words.meaning: Ikel bħal ħaxix u tiben li jingħata lill-annimali.
words.exampleEnglish: He stored the fodder for winter.

words.meaning: Ċereali li jintuża għall-ikel tal-annimali u biex issir il-birra.
words.exampleEnglish: The farmers sowed barley in the big field.

words.meaning: Iz-zkuk niexfa tal-qamħ wara li jinqala’ l-qamħ.
words.exampleEnglish: The horse was lying on the straw.

words.meaning: Pjanta b’weraq irqaq u togħma ħelwa tal-anisi.
words.exampleEnglish: Wild fennel grows along the roads.

words.meaning: Pjanta b’weraq fwieħa u friski, użata fit-te u fil-ikel.
words.exampleEnglish: She made tea with fresh mint.

words.meaning: Pjanta żgħira u fwejħa tax-xagħri; in-naħal jagħmlu għasel tajjeb minnha.
words.exampleEnglish: Thyme honey is famous in Malta.

words.meaning: Siġra b’weraq fwieħa li jitqiegħdu fl-istuffat.
words.exampleEnglish: She added a bay leaf to the stew.

words.meaning: Pjanta tal-ġonna u l-gallariji b’fjuri ħomor jew roża.
words.exampleEnglish: The red geranium decorated the balcony.

words.meaning: Bini tal-ħġieġ jew plastik fejn il-pjanti jikbru fis-sħana.
words.exampleEnglish: The farmer grows tomatoes in the greenhouse.

words.meaning: Kanal żgħir fl-għalqa li jwassal l-ilma lill-pjanti.
words.exampleEnglish: The well water flowed along the channel.

words.meaning: Struttura bil-vireg fejn titla’ d-dielja u tagħti d-dell.
words.exampleEnglish: We sat eating under the pergola.

words.meaning: Biċċa frott waħda, bħal tuffieħa jew lanġasa.
words.exampleEnglish: Eat a piece of fruit every day for your health.

words.meaning: Pjanta waħda li tittiekel, bħal zunnarija jew basla.
words.exampleEnglish: The pumpkin is a very large vegetable.

words.meaning: Frotta żgħira u tonda, bħal waħda mill-għeneb, jew tikka.
words.exampleEnglish: A grape fell to the ground.

words.meaning: Jimxi jew jiċċaqlaq minn post baxx għal wieħed ogħla.
words.exampleEnglish: Grandfather climbs the stairs slowly.

words.meaning: Jirfes l-art u jitla’ fl-arja għal ftit, bħal fenek jew żrinġ.
words.exampleEnglish: The boy skips rope with his friends.

words.meaning: Jiġi ’l isfel f’daqqa minħabba li jitlef il-bilanċ jew il-qabda.
words.example: Meta jiġri fuq il-blat, spiss jaqa’.
words.exampleEnglish: When he runs on the rocks, he often falls.

words.meaning: Jiċċaqlaq lejn il-post fejn tkun int jew lejn post partikolari.
words.example: Ħija jiġi d-dar kull nhar ta’ Ħadd.

words.meaning: Jitlaq minn post u jiċċaqlaq lejn ieħor.
words.exampleEnglish: Every morning he goes to school on foot.

words.meaning: Jilħaq il-post li kien sejjer lejh.
words.example: Il-vapur jasal Għawdex f’ħamsa u għoxrin minuta.
words.exampleEnglish: The ferry arrives in Gozo in twenty-five minutes.

words.meaning: Jitlaq minn ġewwa post u jmur barra.
words.example: Kull filgħaxija joħroġ il-kelb għal mixja.
words.exampleEnglish: Every evening he takes the dog out for a walk.

words.meaning: Jitla’ u jimxi fuq annimal, rota jew vettura.
words.exampleEnglish: All day he rides the bike in the park.

words.meaning: Imexxi karozza jew vettura oħra fit-triq.
words.exampleEnglish: My elder brother drives carefully in the rain.

words.meaning: Jiċċaqlaq fl-arja bil-ġwienaħ jew b’ajruplan.
words.exampleEnglish: The swallow flies low before the rain.

words.meaning: Iċaqlaq ġismu b’ritmu mal-mużika.
words.exampleEnglish: At the feast he dances with the band.

words.meaning: Juża leħnu biex joħroġ kanzunetta jew melodija.
words.example: Fil-kor ikanta bil-qalb kull nhar ta’ Ħadd.
words.exampleEnglish: In the choir he sings with all his heart every Sunday.

words.meaning: Jagħmel il-mużika bi strument; jew iħabbat fuq bieb.

words.meaning: Jagħmel stampa jew disinn bil-lapes, bil-pinna jew bil-kuluri.
words.exampleEnglish: The boy draws the boats in the harbour.

words.meaning: Jaqsam xi ħaġa f’biċċiet b’sikkina, mqass jew serrieq.

words.meaning: Iġib xi ħaġa lejh billi jaqbadha u jkaxkarha.

words.meaning: Jagħfas xi ħaġa ’l bogħod minnu biex tiċċaqlaq.
words.exampleEnglish: He pushes the baby's pram to the garden.

words.meaning: Jieħu xi ħaġa f’idejh u jżommha.

words.meaning: Ibiegħed xi ħaġa minn idejh bil-qawwa minn ġo l-arja.
words.exampleEnglish: He throws the ball to the dog in the garden.

words.meaning: Jagħmel xi ħaġa biex jagħmilha eħfef għal ħaddieħor.
words.exampleEnglish: Every Saturday he helps Grandfather in the field.

words.meaning: Jieħu xi ħaġa li mhix tiegħu mingħajr permess.
words.example: Fl-istorja, il-volpi tisraq it-tiġieġ, imma l-ġurdien jisraq il-ġobon.
words.exampleEnglish: In the story, the fox steals the hens, but the mouse steals the cheese.

words.meaning: Jagħmel xi ħaġa f’biċċiet jew iwaqqafha milli taħdem.
words.example: Kull darba li jilgħab il-ballun ġewwa jikser xi ħaġa.
words.exampleEnglish: Every time he plays ball indoors he breaks something.

words.meaning: Jagħmel xi ħaġa miksura terġa’ taħdem.
words.exampleEnglish: The mechanic repairs the luzzu's engine.

words.meaning: Jgħaddi ż-żebgħa fuq ħajt, bieb jew oġġett.
words.example: Kull rebbiegħa jiżbogħ il-bieb tad-dar aħdar.
words.exampleEnglish: Every spring he paints the front door green.

words.meaning: Jagħmel toqba jew fossa fl-art bil-pala jew b’magna.
words.example: Il-kelb iħaffer fil-ġnien biex jaħbi l-għadma.
words.exampleEnglish: The dog digs in the garden to hide the bone.

words.meaning: Iqiegħed pjanta jew żerriegħa fil-ħamrija biex tikber.
words.example: Kull ħarifa Pawl iħawwel il-basal fl-għalqa.
words.exampleEnglish: Every autumn Paul plants onions in the field.

words.meaning: Jitfa’ l-ilma fuq il-pjanti biex ma jinxfux.
words.exampleEnglish: The gardener waters the garden plants in the evening.

words.meaning: Iħallat u jagħfas id-dqiq mal-ilma biex jagħmel għaġina.

words.meaning: Isajjar ħobż, kejk jew ikel ieħor fis-sħana tal-forn.
words.exampleEnglish: For Christmas he bakes chestnut biscuits.

words.meaning: Isajjar l-ikel fiż-żejt jew fix-xaħam sħun f’taġen.
words.example: Il-ħajjat kien jaqli l-bajd qabel ix-xogħol.

words.meaning: Isajjar l-ikel fuq nar jew grill.
words.exampleEnglish: In summer he grills fish on the beach.

words.meaning: Jispjega u juri lil ħaddieħor biex jitgħallem xi ħaġa.

words.meaning: Jikseb għarfien jew ħila ġdida billi jistudja jew jipprova.

words.meaning: Ikun jaf it-tifsira jew ir-raġuni ta’ xi ħaġa.

words.meaning: Juża moħħu biex jiddeċiedi, jiftakar jew jimmaġina.
words.exampleEnglish: Before answering he thinks carefully.

words.meaning: Jagħżel x’se jagħmel wara li jaħseb.
words.exampleEnglish: Every time he decides at the last minute.

words.meaning: Jgħid jew jikteb xi ħaġa wara mistoqsija jew ittra.

words.meaning: Jgħid isem xi ħadd biex jiġi; jew iċempel.

words.meaning: Jitkellem jew jgħajjat b’leħen qawwi ħafna.

words.meaning: Ipoġġi ħwejjeġ, żraben jew aċċessorji fuq ġismu.

words.meaning: Jesprimi xi ħaġa bil-kliem.

words.meaning: Jgħid lil ħaddieħor x’ġara jew storja.

words.meaning: Isib kemm hi twila, tqila jew kbira xi ħaġa.

words.meaning: Isib kemm hemm billi jgħid in-numri wieħed wara l-ieħor.

words.meaning: Jagħmel li xi ħaġa tasal għand xi ħadd ieħor.

words.meaning: Jieħu xi ħaġa li ntbagħtet jew ingħatat lilu.
words.example: Għal għeluq sninu jirċievi ħafna rigali.

words.meaning: Jgħaddi xi ħaġa f’idejn ħaddieħor.

words.meaning: Jagħti l-flus għal xi ħaġa li xtara jew użata.

words.meaning: Jgħaqqad ħajtu ma’ persuna oħra fiż-żwieġ.

words.meaning: Jasal fit-tmiem tal-ħajja.
words.exampleEnglish: At the end of the film the hero doesn't die.

words.meaning: Ikun ħaj; jew joqgħod f’post.

words.meaning: Isir akbar jew itwal maż-żmien.

words.meaning: Jieqaf jaħdem jew jiċċaqlaq biex jerġa’ jieħu s-saħħa.
words.exampleEnglish: After lunch he rests for half an hour.

words.meaning: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jieqaf jorqod.

words.meaning: Jara stampi u stejjer f’moħħu waqt li jorqod.
words.exampleEnglish: Every night he dreams that he flies.

words.meaning: Iħoss li hemm periklu u jkun irid jaħrab.
words.exampleEnglish: The boy is afraid of the dark.

words.meaning: Juri l-ferħ billi jgħolli t-truf tax-xufftejn.
words.example: It-tarbija titbissem, u missierha jitbissem lura.
words.exampleEnglish: The baby smiles, and her father smiles back.

words.meaning: Imiss lil xi ħadd bix-xufftejn bħala sinjal ta’ mħabba.
words.example: Kull filgħaxija jbewwes lit-tfal qabel jorqdu.
words.exampleEnglish: Every evening he kisses the children before they sleep.

words.meaning: Jagħlaq dirgħajh madwar xi ħadd b’imħabba.
words.example: Meta jasal l-ajruport iħaddan lil ommu.
words.exampleEnglish: When he arrives at the airport he hugs his mother.

words.meaning: Ikellem lil Alla; jew jistaqsi lil xi ħadd biex jagħtih xi ħaġa.

words.meaning: Jgħid kelma ta’ tislima meta jiltaqa’ jew jitlaq minn xi ħadd.

words.meaning: Ikollu xi ħaġa f’idejh u ma jitlaqhiex; jew jibqa’ jieħu ħsiebha.
words.exampleEnglish: He keeps the dog on the lead in the street.

words.meaning: Iġib affarijiet f’post wieħed jew jaqbadhom minn mal-art.

words.meaning: Iħares madwaru biex isib xi ħaġa jew xi ħadd.

words.meaning: Jara jew jilħaq xi ħaġa li kien qed ifittex jew li ma kienx jistenna.

words.meaning: Jifhem jew jara xi ħaġa li qabel ma kienx jaf biha.
words.example: Wara ftit jinduna li nesa l-portmoni.
words.exampleEnglish: After a while he realises he forgot his wallet.

words.meaning: Jaqbad xi ħaġa bis-snien u jagħfas.

words.meaning: Iġiegħel l-ikel jew ix-xorb jgħaddi mill-gerżuma.

words.meaning: Ineħħi l-ilma jew l-umdità minn xi ħaġa.
words.example: Wara l-banju Ġorġ inixxef il-kelb bix-xugaman.
words.exampleEnglish: After the bath George dries the dog with the towel.

words.meaning: Inaddaf l-art billi jgħaddi l-ixkupa.

words.meaning: Iqiegħed l-affarijiet f’ordni jew isewwi xi ħaġa.

words.meaning: Jiċċaqlaq bla ma jerfa’ saqajh fuq wiċċ lixx.
words.exampleEnglish: On the wet tiles he slips easily.

words.meaning: Jgħolli xi ħaġa minn mal-art.
words.exampleEnglish: The worker lifts the heavy stones.

words.meaning: Iqiegħed xi ħaġa f’post partikolari.
words.exampleEnglish: George puts the books on the shelf.

words.meaning: Jieħu xi ħaġa minn fejn tinsab.
words.exampleEnglish: Before entering the house he takes off his shoes.

words.meaning: Jerfa’ xi ħaġa u jeħodha minn post għal ieħor.
words.exampleEnglish: The donkey carries the baskets of vegetables.

words.meaning: Jieħu xi ħaġa jew lil xi ħadd sa post partikolari.
words.example: Is-sewwieq iwassal lit-tfal l-iskola kull filgħodu.

words.meaning: Jitlaq xi ħaġa warajh; jew jippermetti.
words.exampleEnglish: He leaves the umbrella in the car.

words.meaning: Jiggwida jew jikkontrolla grupp, negozju jew vettura.
words.exampleEnglish: The captain steers the ship towards the harbour.

words.meaning: Jagħmel dak li jgħidlu jew li jordnalu xi ħadd ieħor.

words.meaning: Juża l-qawwa jew il-kliem kontra xi ħadd ieħor.
words.exampleEnglish: The cat fights with the neighbours' dog.

words.meaning: Jieqaf ikun irrabjat ma’ xi ħadd li għamel ħażin.
words.example: Ommu dejjem taħfer, u hu jaħfer ukoll.
words.exampleEnglish: His mother always forgives, and he forgives too.

words.meaning: Jitlaq malajr minn post jew minn periklu.
words.exampleEnglish: The mouse escapes from the cat.

words.meaning: Iżomm żewġ affarijiet flimkien b’ħabel jew spag.
words.exampleEnglish: The fisherman ties the boat to the quay.

words.meaning: Jiftaħ għoqda jew rabta.
words.exampleEnglish: He unties his laces before taking off his shoes.

words.meaning: Iġiegħel xi ħaġa tiċċaqlaq f’ċirku jew tbiddel direzzjoni.
words.exampleEnglish: He turns the key twice in the lock.

words.meaning: Jibda d-dawl, magna jew nar.
words.exampleEnglish: When it gets dark he switches on the lamp.

words.meaning: Iwaqqaf id-dawl, magna jew nar.
words.exampleEnglish: Before going out he switches off all the lights.

words.meaning: Li għandu togħma ta’ zokkor jew għasel.
words.exampleEnglish: The tea was too sweet for me.

words.meaning: Li għandu togħma tal-melħ.
words.exampleEnglish: The sea is salty, rivers are not.

words.meaning: Li m’huwiex għoli; qrib l-art.
words.example: Il-ħajt baxx tal-ġnien ma jżommx il-kelb.
words.exampleEnglish: The low garden wall doesn't keep the dog in.

words.meaning: Li jasal ’il bogħod ’l isfel mill-wiċċ.
words.exampleEnglish: Grandfather's well is very deep.

words.meaning: Li għandu wiċċ lixx u ndaqs, mingħajr tlugħ u nżul.
words.example: Il-Bajja ta’ Għajn Tuffieħa għandha ramel ċatt.
words.exampleEnglish: Għajn Tuffieħa bay has flat sand.

words.meaning: Li għandu forma ta’ ċirku jew ta’ ballun.
words.example: It-tarbija għandha wiċċ tond u ħaddejn ħomor.
words.exampleEnglish: The baby has a round face and red cheeks.

words.meaning: Li ma jitgħawwiġx; li jmur f’direzzjoni waħda.
words.exampleEnglish: He walked straight to the door.

words.meaning: Li m’huwiex dritt, li għandu liwja.
words.exampleEnglish: The nail came out of the wall bent.

words.meaning: Li għandu wiċċ ċatt u mhux ħarxa meta tmissu.
